1# Repository work instructions23Extend the existing Kotlin/Compose app. Preserve Room records, registered migrations, encrypted storage, scanner and the offline-only architecture. Do not add INTERNET permission, telemetry or destructive migrations. Read the current PROGRESS.md and VALIDATION.md before resuming historical work.45For every new distributable APK, follow RELEASING.md and use `python scripts/release.py --bump patch|minor|major --notes <reviewed-notes.md> --variant debug` (or the documented same-key optimized release path). Choose the semantic bump from the actual scope; never bump merely for a failed build. Do not hand-edit old APK names or replace their historical metadata. Keep version.properties, CHANGELOG.md, RELEASES.md, releases/history.json and APK checksums consistent with verified binary metadata. Preserve the original signing certificate and package. A plain Gradle build is reproducible and is not a new release.67Finish source changes before lint. Run appropriate host tests, build the app and test APK, then run optimized release and lint sequentially. Keep prior progress/validation records when updating their current section. Record native-versus-host coverage and device-verification limits honestly. Never clear or uninstall the owner's application to prepare a test; use an isolated temporary Android test user and clean up only that fixture.

1# Android project audit and cleanup2318 October 2026, Malaysia. Baseline: `233d43d8c831514740a6c4f983202cc2afa3549e`. Protected checkpoint: `checkpoint/pre-audit-2026-10-18`. The working tree was clean before inspection. [Original request](docs/audit-2026-10-18/REQUEST.md).45## Scope and files reviewed67The audit covered the whole tracked repository, rather than only the latest diff: **291 files**. [Complete inventory with baseline sizes and SHA256](docs/audit-2026-10-18/REVIEW_INVENTORY.tsv). Categories: 62 production Kotlin files; 36 host-test/helper files; 2 native-test files; 5 Room schemas; 37 manifest/resource/license files; 3 build-policy files; 14 build/release tooling files; 118 documentation/reference-render files; 14 release artifacts/metadata files.89Repository-wide declaration/reference, resource/manifest, suspicious-file, logging/network, coroutine/lifecycle and build-configuration scans were combined with code review of the entry point, ViewModels, repositories, transactions, migrations, money/fuel/planning utilities, scanner and backup/security boundaries. Existing test assertions were reviewed against these paths. Static references are evidence, not proof of every possible runtime behavior; reflection, framework entry points, serialization and generated Room code were considered before removal. This is a code/automated QA audit, not a guarantee that every device/provider interaction is fault-free.1011## Deleted file and removed content1213| Item | Evidence and reason |14| --- | --- |15| `app/proguard-rules.pro` | Its entire content was one explanatory comment. No rules were defined. Remove its build reference; retain Android's default optimized configuration and dependency consumer rules. |16| Generated `app_name` and `app_version` string entries in `app/build.gradle.kts` | No Kotlin/XML/runtime lookup references. Installed launcher naming uses retained `app_display_name`; About reads PackageManager. Neither application ID nor installed version naming changes. |17| 19 explicit imports across 10 Kotlin files | No usage after excluding import declarations; compilation verifies removal. Delegated `getValue`/`setValue` operators were retained. [Exact inventory](docs/audit-2026-10-18/REMOVED_IMPORTS.json). |1819No Kotlin source file, icon, image, migration, entity, test, license or intentionally retained APK was deleted. No accidental tracked caches/logs/backup copies were found. `buildSrc/.../build` is an active Java package, not a disposable build directory. Local build caches are already ignored and were retained for reproducibility/verification.2021## Dependencies removed2223- `androidx.room:room-ktx:2.8.5`: empty compatibility AAR; coroutine APIs are in retained `room-runtime:2.8.5`.24- `androidx.work:work-runtime-ktx:2.12.0`: empty compatibility AAR; use retained/referenced `work-runtime:2.12.0` directly.2526Both inspected `classes.jar` archives contained only their `META-INF/...version` marker, no classes. There is no promised APK-size saving from removing empty artifacts. No dependency version was upgraded. Compose/compiler/KSP/serialization plugins are active; SQLCipher, Tink, bundled ML Kit, Fragment/Biometric, DataStore, EXIF and Material icons have actual runtime/build uses and remain.2728## Duplicate logic and performance changes2930- Reuse the same private numeric fuel-point validator in sequence validation, provisional intervals and supplementary full-cycle history. Formulas, accepted bounds and failure messages stay unchanged.31- Read allocation category IDs once per save, instead of querying inside each category membership check.32- Read saved journeys once per transactional edit, instead of twice for link uniqueness and prior links.33- Precompute fixed-expense IDs for monthly allowance/refund filtering and financial reports. Membership sets replace repeated linear searches without changing cross-period refund semantics.34- Preserve the existing feature packages, shared screen margins/theme/cards, press-feedback adapters, remembered computations, lazy containers and stable pager keys. No package reshuffle, screen resizing, global scale, new architecture or animation change was justified.35- Ignore disposable `.DS_Store` and heap dumps in addition to existing build, Python, IDE and signing exclusions.3637## Verified defects and fixes38391. **Undo could over-refund a purchase.** A RM10 purchase edited to RM20 could receive a RM15 refund; Undo then restored RM10 while retaining RM15 refunded. A new API26/35 repository regression failed before the fix. Undo now checks all current linked refunds against the proposed restored amount inside its transaction and rejects conflicting restoration without consuming the Undo entry. After resolving the refund, the same Undo succeeds.402. **A refund could pay a fixed commitment through the repository.** The visible picker already limits choices, but the repository accepted a refund ID and stored invalid recurring metadata. A new planner regression failed before the fix. The repository now requires an ordinary Expense and validates the copied linked record before writing. Rejection preserves the refund and leaves the commitment unpaid.413. **Native launch verification was incomplete.** The old native suite tested encrypted storage without launching the production Activity. Added `ProductionStartupTest`, restricted to an isolated Android user, checks airplane mode, actual readiness/categories, screenshot flags and ViewModel identity through Activity recreation. The initial ActivityScenario harness timed out waiting for an idle event queue; direct lifecycle observation avoids that harness assumption while retaining actual readiness assertions. On baseline 1.5.1 the replacement test passed in 129.298s. A later standalone launch also visibly reached Overview with the calendar and navigation; [actual baseline capture](docs/audit-2026-10-18/baseline-native-home-api26.png). That duration is a software-emulator concern, not a claimed startup optimization or a proven explanation of every previous loading observation.4243The three new financial regression executions failed before the guards and pass after them. No failing assertion was disabled.4445## Feature and data safety review4647| Existing feature | Review and regression coverage |48| --- | --- |49| Home, Expenses, income, Calendar | Local date/zone rollovers, actual spending, refund/category history, exact sen and historical payment strings; existing host UI/repository suites. |50| Fuel and Journey | Consecutive valid ODO intervals, later-fill litres, weighted volume/distance, provisional assumptions; old fields/full-cycle display retained; Journey formulas/legacy JSON and route form preserved. |51| Analysis, monthly planner and recurring bills | Fixed versus variable spending, planned reserves, allocation rounding/100% validation, manual links, recurrence cursor/unique occurrence index and reports; new rejection tests. |52| Scanner and attachments | Bundled Latin ML Kit model, local parsing/category mappings, ambiguity/duplicate checks, petrol review, private images and Undo retained. |53| Widgets and navigation | Three manifest receivers, serialized updates, stable five-page pager/ViewModels, child gesture ownership and detail/form navigation retained. |54| Appearance, app lock and screenshots | Persistent System/Light/Dark preference, independent Settings writes, reduced motion/haptics, lock/timeout behavior and screenshot allowance retained. |55| Encrypted backup/export | SQLCipher/Keystore, Tink authenticated streaming through EOF, bounded/validated staging, CSV injection protection, PDF and legacy backup import retained. |5657Room remains **schema5**. Schemas1–5, migration1→2→3→4→5, serialized field names, IDs, hidden historical fields and backup versions are unchanged. No destructive fallback or cleanup migration was added. All manual device checks use an isolated test user; no owner database, app data or original gallery images are cleared. Tests demonstrate fixture safety; unavailable physical-phone records cannot be directly certified.5859## Offline/security findings6061Source has no production financial logging, HTTP client, cloud sync, Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics or Internet permission. Manifest actively removes network permissions; automatic backup and device-transfer rules exclude local data. The external camera/document/photo-picker integrations and three widget receivers are active, not unused files. Screenshot permission intentionally permits capture by prior request; app-lock and encryption remain.6263Bundled OCR's reviewed telemetry sinks remain build-time no-ops; transport runtime/CCT artifacts are excluded, and the policy verifies pinned sink shapes. Removing that policy would weaken offline/privacy guarantees. Default backups are password-encrypted; no key/password is included in Git or this report. Captured test images use empty/sample profiles.6465## Intentionally retained and uncertain items6667- Every historical APK and dated release/render/progress/validation record: expressly retained history. They dominate repository size; deletion would violate the request.68- Compose previews and private sample fixtures: Android Studio tooling entry points; samples never enter production storage. They are not abandoned runtime screens.69- Manifest receivers, worker, provider, Room declarations/schema JSON, serialization fields and licenses: framework/generated/reflection uses.70- Shared interaction wrappers with Material-like names: deliberate existing application-wide ripple/semantics policy. Existing regression tests guard it.71- Legacy payment values, full-tank flags, hidden Journey/refuel fields, old backup readers and dormant dashboard preferences: historical compatibility. Absence from a visible control does not establish safe deletion.72- Large screen/ViewModel files and broad wildcard imports: potential gradual maintainability work, not evidence of dead code. No cosmetic package rewrite performed.73- SQLite/KTX suggestions and deprecated test APIs require separate dependency/API migration review. Version upgrades are outside this safe cleanup.7475## Build, QA and release results7677Pre-release compilation, debug APK and instrumentation APK builds pass. All **309 host tests** across 35 suites pass with zero failures/errors/skips; **6 release-workflow tests** pass. Optimized release build and lint pass: **0 errors, 4 warnings, 1 hint**, down from 10 warnings. Binary package/version/signature, original-certificate match, 16KiB alignment and no-network policy pass. On this exact1.5.2 APK, all nine native OCR/financial/backup/encryption/migration cases passed. The additional startup case timed out at its first-state30s budget in the combined run (10 cases, one failure;442.941s). With the first-state budget aligned to readiness at120s, a separate startup/readiness/recreation follow-up passed (`OK (1 test)`,125.352s) on the same APK. The failure and retest are recorded separately; no all-ten-in-one-pass claim is made for1.5.2. This does not establish physical-device startup performance. Four build-policy Java tests were freshly rerun and pass. No version is advanced for a failed check. The two verified financial fixes justified the PATCH release through the existing same-certificate workflow after all release gates passed. [Combined run and follow-up evidence](docs/audit-2026-10-18/native/).7879Audit artifact: `downloads/FuelExpenseTracker_v1.5.2.apk`, version **1.5.2/code9**, 76,258,773 bytes, SHA256 `23c98bd572940d241fc730760e201ca05095f8223c57e981913d977978ff6c3d`. Signed debug with the original certificate; package `my.fuelledger`. No previous artifact was overwritten. Source checkpoint `48e3c51`. A subsequent CLARITY UI refinement is a separate phase, not part of these audit changes.808119 October follow-on: the complete ten-case native suite passed on1.5.3/code10, including actual production readiness/recreation. The final1.5.4/code11 CLARITY host release gate passes316 tests across39 suites, debug/test/optimized builds and lint with0 errors/4 warnings/1 hint. See [CLARITY_REPORT.md](CLARITY_REPORT.md) for subsequent UI changes, exact-APK checks and visual/device limits, and the [complete combined file inventory](docs/clarity-2026-10-18/MODIFIED_FILES.txt). Room schema5, entities, migrations, original certificate and all historical APKs remain unchanged.

1# Fuel & Expense Tracker23A native Android app for personal spending and car fuel records. Kotlin, Jetpack Compose / Material 3, MVVM, Room and DataStore. Designed for offline use with no account, server, advertising or Internet permission. Structured records, settings and retained receipt photos are encrypted locally. Receipt selection uses the system picker without broad gallery permissions. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) and [VALIDATION.md](VALIDATION.md) for the architecture, dependency review and precise verification limits.45## Download the APK67[**Download Fuel & Expense Tracker v1.5.4**](https://github.com/Piccol1001/ChatgptFuelConsumption/raw/refs/heads/main/downloads/FuelExpenseTracker_v1.5.4.apk)89Version **1.5.4 / code11**, signed debug build, Android8.0 or later. The APK uses the original `my.fuelledger` package and signing certificate for compatible in-place updates. Open the link on your phone, download the `.apk`, then open it to install. The binary is also in `downloads/`; its verified metadata and checksum are in [RELEASES.md](RELEASES.md) and `downloads/SHA256SUMS`.1011The audit and CLARITY refinement extend the existing app. See [cleanup findings](CLEANUP_REPORT.md), [UI changes and screenshots](CLARITY_REPORT.md) and [test results and device limits](VALIDATION.md). Financial records, Room schema5/migrations, encrypted backups and offline processing are preserved. The main screens have no app-name/version header; Settings → About reads the installed version.1213Existing launcher/splash branding is retained. The selected Option4 replacement is deferred under the user's instruction because `design-assets/Fuel_Expense_Logo_Option_4.png` and `design-assets/Fuel_Expense_Android_Adaptive_Foreground.png` are still unavailable. No substitute logo was generated.1415## Install on your phone1617Requires **Android8.0 or later**. Open the APK in your browser or file manager and allow installation from that source when Android requests it.213. Install over the existing app, using the same original signing identity. Do not uninstall to apply this update; local financial records remain in the existing database.224. Open **Fuel & Expense Tracker v1.5.4**. The app and bundled receipt recognition operate offline, including first use.2324This distribution preserves the existing development signing key. Future distributions must follow [RELEASING.md](RELEASING.md).2526## Build in Android Studio (beginner workflow)27281. Do not commit machine-specific paths. SDKs, downloaded dependencies and signing keys are outside source control.4344## Using the app4546Swipe left/right between **Home → Expenses → Fuel → Journey → Analysis**, or tap the matching bottom tab. Pages stop at either end and retain their drafts and scroll positions. Category rows, the Journey toggle and chart regions keep their own gestures; forms, Settings, scanner and planner configuration retain their existing Back behavior. Wide windows use a navigation rail with the same pager selection. See [current UI implementation and verification](CLARITY_REPORT.md).4748Journey now shares the reference screens' content margins, omits empty suggestion spacing, and uses concise labels that fit small phones. See the [measured layout investigation and matching screenshots](docs/journey-layout/README.md).4950- **Home:** compact date/Overview header; navy card with actual today’s expenses, monthly expenses and income received; right-aligned monthly budget, two Add Expense/Add Fuel actions, shared Spending Calendar, upcoming payments and an amount-privacy eye control. No bank balance or safe-to-spend recommendation is shown.51- **Fuel:** weighted provisional odometer consumption after two valid fills, retained per-fill/full-cycle history, recent change detection, actual price history and estimated fuel/recorded transport costs per kilometre with coverage labels.52- **Expenses:** favourites, merchant/category/payment memory, refunds, duplicate warnings, persistent Undo, configurable row swipes and advanced date/category/payment/type/search filters. Others stays last; category filters remain below Transaction history. The embedded shared Spending Calendar shows actual daily records and supports date-seeded entry. Dedicated Fuel is omitted from manual entry; historical fuel records and general Transport/Parking/Tolls remain.53- **Analysis:** actual income and net expenses, category/daily/monthly trends, budget performance, paid fixed/variable spending, planned forecasts/reserves, local insights, vehicle statistics and local CSV/PDF reports. Select current/previous/3/6/12-month or custom ranges. Daily expenditure scrolls horizontally, starts centred on today and offers a Today action; the Monthly plan vs actual card is removed.54- **Journey:** named local routes and presets, reverse direction, independent outbound/return distances and tolls, price scenarios, explicit existing-expense links, estimated/actual comparisons and text/PNG sharing. Planning/linking creates no transactions; missing actuals remain unavailable.55- **Settings:** one Monthly Money Planner, recurring transactions, existing allocation sliders, themes, scanner, privacy, app lock, category management, local data cleanup, exports and encrypted backups. Gestures/feedback and dashboard arrangement entries are removed; built-in behavior remains. About → App Version shows actual installed metadata.56- **Home-screen widgets:** monthly expense/budget summary, quick-add shortcuts and actual income/expenses/net cash flow. Amounts are hidden by default; widgets use local updates and the device's light/dark appearance.5758[Current changes, calculation assumptions, screenshot policy and verification](docs/refinement-2026-10-17/IMPLEMENTATION.md). [Prior comprehensive upgrade](docs/comprehensive-upgrade/IMPLEMENTATION.md).5960Each refuel automatically creates one expense in **Fuel & Transport**. Editing or deleting it updates or deletes that expense in the same SQLite transaction. Tap a linked expense to open its refuel editor. Historical manually entered Fuel & Transport expenses remain independent and accessible; new refuelling belongs in Add Refuel. Do not record the same pump payment twice.6162Enter the **ODO reading and litres purchased at every fill-up**, including partial fills. The first record establishes a baseline. Each later record shows distance since the preceding ODO reading, estimated km/L, L/100 km and cost/km using the current purchase's litres and payment. For example, 10,000 km followed by 10,500 km with 40 L gives a **12.50 km/L per-fill estimate**. Tank levels can vary, so this is explicitly an estimate rather than measured consumption. New entries default to RON95 and use the cents-first keypad. Optional fuel-type changes, station and receipts are under Receipt & station. Location, full-tank and notes inputs are removed; historical values remain unchanged when edited.6364The primary **Estimated Fuel Consumption** needs two valid increasing-odometer/date readings; full tanks are not required. Each interval uses the later fill’s litres. Historical L/100 km is 100 × total included litres ÷ total included distance, and km/L is total distance ÷ total litres. The baseline purchase is excluded, and each later purchase appears once. This assumes equal fuel levels after each refuel; arbitrary partial fills can be inaccurate because fuel remaining in the tank is unknown. Invalid/equal odometers, invalid quantities and ambiguous same-time order do not produce an interval. Original full-tank fields and verified full-cycle history remain available as supplementary historical information. This app tracks **one vehicle**.6566The same weighted estimate updates Fuel, Journey and analytics after refuel edits/deletions. Fallback consumption is used only after explicit entry/enablement when no valid history exists. The estimator uses distance × consumption ÷ 100 and actual petrol price. The example 150 km, 7 L/100 km, RM2.05/L produces **10.50 L, RM21.53, RM0.1435/km and 14.29 km/L**. Estimated money uses decimal HALF_UP rounding; stored payments use exact integer sen.6768Week totals use Monday–Sunday. Calendar totals and date filters use the phone's local time zone, including daylight saving changes; timestamps are stored as epoch milliseconds. Changing the device time zone can change the calendar day a transaction appears under. Analysis daily averages include every calendar day in the selected range, including empty days. Spending Calendar uses elapsed days for the current month and full days for other months.6970### Adding and editing expenses7172Tap **Add Expense** on Home or **Add Expense** in Expenses, choose an icon in the horizontal category row (custom categories are retained, Others stays last), and use the cents-first keypad. Starting at RM 0.00, digits 1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 5 produce RM 0.01 → RM 0.12 → RM 1.23 → RM 12.34 → RM 123.45. Backspace removes the last digit; Clear resets to zero. There is no decimal key or software keyboard for the amount. Save requires a positive amount and a selected payment method; values are exact integer sen and limited to the existing RM1,000,000,000 maximum.7374Choose **E-Wallet**, **Cash** or **Card** in that order. The last selected method is saved in encrypted local DataStore, including when cancelling the draft, and highlighted for the next new expense (initially Cash). Existing Credit Card/Debit Card payments display as Card but retain their original stored strings when edited within that group. Historical Not specified records remain intact and prompt for an explicit method before saving changes. Existing amounts initialize directly from their stored sen; untouched transaction timestamps retain their original precision.7576Open **Details & receipt** for date, time, merchant, description, collapsed notes, Photo Picker/camera and offline OCR review. Choose Refund there for an unlinked refund, or use a transaction’s Actions → Record refund to link it to the purchase. Favourites can be created from Actions or the editor details and managed in Expenses. Collapsing the section retains the attachment. The expense list's category filters now sit directly below **Transaction history**; their filtering, scrolling and ordering are unchanged. Main screens retain their clean titles without the app-name/version header.7778### Touch feedback7980App controls use a subtle 0.98× press animation instead of grey ripple overlays. The drawing shrinks for roughly 90ms and returns smoothly over 130ms; touch targets, layout and accessibility semantics keep their original bounds. Selected categories, chips, navigation and the journey toggle use accent colours, and keyboard focus has a rounded accent outline. Android's Remove animations / animator duration scale is respected: scaling is disabled at zero, and the app only reads that system preference. The shared policy covers the app, dialogs, app-lock screen and previews in both themes. Standard date/time input internals retain their native selection/editing behavior with the grey ripple suppressed.8182## Receipt photos and offline scanning8384In Add/Edit Expense, open **Details & receipt**; in Add/Edit Refuel, open **Receipt & station**, then select **Choose receipt photo**. The app reads the original without changing it and retains a normalized, orientation-correct JPEG copy encrypted in private storage. You can view, replace or remove the attachment. No public receipt album is created.8586**Scan & review receipt** runs the bundled Latin OCR model locally. Edit suggested merchant, total, date/time, category and applicable fuel details before applying selected fields to the form. ODO is suggested only when explicitly printed. Unit prices, tax and loyalty values are not treated as totals. Blurry or ambiguous receipts need manual correction; scanning inside an existing form always waits for you to save. The separate dashboard scanner supports the optional Smart Auto-Save mode described below. Choose the delete-after-extraction option if you do not want to retain the imported copy. Removing an existing saved photo takes effect when the transaction edit is saved; cancelling preserves the original record.8788## Monthly Money Planner and allocation8990Open Settings → Financial Planning → **Monthly Money Planner**. Choose **Expected Income → Sources** to set multiple Salary, Allowance, Stock / Investment Income, Passive Income, Part-Time Income or Other Income sources. Optional irregular estimates can be blank; zero estimates never become received income. Use **Expected Income → Received** for actual received-income records. Choose **Fixed Monthly Expenses** to manage rent, subscriptions and other commitments. Both reuse the existing recurrence rules; daily, weekly and monthly schedules support start/end dates and pause/resume. For a monthly bill on the 29th–31st, shorter months use their last day and the following month returns to the original day.9192The Monthly Money Planner distinguishes:9394- **Planned available:** expected income − fixed commitments.95- **Actual monthly net cash flow:** income received − all actual recorded expenses.96- **Remaining spending allowance:** planned available − variable/unreserved spending. A payment linked to a fixed occurrence reserved in the selected month is excluded from variable spending, while remaining in expenditure and budget reports. An early/late payment for another month's commitment counts as unreserved spending in its actual payment month.9798New fixed expenses wait for confirmation. In **Overview & payments**, record a payment once or link an existing expense; linked refuelling transactions cannot be reused as fixed payments. Existing automatic recurring expenses retain their behavior and use the same rule IDs. To convert one, edit that existing rule and enable **Confirm payments manually**. Editing the actual transaction updates payment history; deleting a manual payment reopens its occurrence. Expected income never becomes actual received income automatically.99100Use month arrows to compare saved past plans and preview future months. Reconciliation catches missed months when the app opens; it does not require continuous background operation. Captured past plans stay unchanged when rules change; uncaptured historical months are reconstructed from the rules available when first opened. Current plans reflect rule edits. Pausing excludes a rule from new projections; old saved months remain available.101102Within the same **Monthly Money Planner → Monthly Allocation** screen, choose defaults or an override for the selected month. Drag category sliders and inspect the live donut and RM amounts. Only the selected category and the named flexible remainder exchange percentages; totals always stay at 100% without negative values. To adjust the remainder directly, first choose another flexible category. Edit names and spending-category mappings, add/remove custom categories, then save. Removing a category returns its percentage to the remainder. Each spending category may map to one allocation. Allocation rounding distributes every sen; zero/negative available amounts allocate RM 0.00 and keep the shortfall visible. Savings is a planned reserve, not an expense or transfer. Month overrides do not change defaults; changing defaults preserves captured past allocation plans. Allocations never create transactions or deduct fixed commitments a second time.103104Optional **Local planning reminders** are checked when the app opens and roughly every 12 hours, subject to Android scheduling. They cover upcoming/unpaid bills and income shortfalls, use generic private notification text, and request notification permission only when enabled on Android 13+. Android settings may need to re-enable previously denied notifications.105106## Journey Planner107108Tap **Journey** in bottom navigation. Enter origin and destination names and a manual one-way driving distance; saved locations appear as offline suggestions. Place names never generate distances. Tap or drag the One Way / Round Trip pill and edit the return distance. The live historical fuel average is selected automatically. Enable **Override this journey** only if needed. Without history, enter a labelled fallback and optionally save it for new journeys. Petrol price remains editable. Return distance initially copies outbound distance; return tolls are never doubled automatically.109110Add one total toll entry or several named toll segments for each direction, plus total parking. New estimates equal **fuel + tolls + parking**, using the existing fuel estimator and integer-sen fees. Other-fee and passenger-sharing controls are removed. Existing saved journeys retain their original fields and totals through a versioned JSON compatibility path; explicitly saving an edit uses the new formula. Legacy journeys reopen with their saved consumption; new journeys remember whether consumption came from history, a fallback or an explicit override. Reopening a history-based journey uses the latest average; saved history lists retain the original estimate until an edit is saved. Save, edit, delete or duplicate a journey using the latest default petrol price. Saved plans and locations remain local and are included in encrypted backups. No journey estimate is posted to Expenses or Fuel Tracker.111112## Automatic offline receipt scanner113114Tap **Scan receipt** in Expenses (or use the existing Scan widget shortcut). Use **Take receipt photo** or Android Photo Picker. Camera capture uses the device's camera app through a narrowly scoped private FileProvider; the app needs no camera or gallery permission. Camera failure/denial leaves gallery selection available. The temporary private camera file is removed after import; abandoned camera files are cleaned after 24 hours on the next app startup. Gallery originals are unchanged. Imported photos, crop/rotate results and retained attachments are encrypted privately. Long portrait receipts keep up to 4096 pixels on their long side, subject to pixel/file limits.115116Recognition uses the bundled ML Kit Latin model, including on first offline launch. Crop top/bottom borders or rotate 90° and rescan if needed. Parser rules rank final totals and reject subtotal, tax, tendered cash and change. Missing or conflicting values remain for review. Low contrast, likely blur, small images, ambiguous totals/dates, foreign currencies, unknown categories, petrol receipts and possible duplicates prevent automatic saving.117118Settings → **Receipt Scanner → Save Mode** offers **Review Before Saving** (default) and **Smart Auto-Save**. Review mode fills editable merchant, amount, date and category fields. Smart mode requires clear, validated values and no duplicate indicators. Successful saving updates the existing expense, budget, allowance and analytics flows and shows **Undo saved receipt expense**. Undo removes only an unchanged saved receipt transaction and its duplicate marker; an edited transaction must be reviewed in Expenses before deletion. Normal expense deletion retains a receipt fingerprint to prevent accidental rescanning as a new charge.119120Exact normalized OCR fingerprints are unique in Room. Same-day/same-amount transactions trigger conservative duplicate review. Match a petrol receipt to its existing linked refuel expense using **Use existing transaction** to avoid a second charge; an explicitly confirmed distinct purchase can be recorded after review. Retaining the receipt is optional. Delete a retained photo later through its expense/refuel editor without deleting the transaction.121122Correct a category and enable **Remember this merchant's category**, or add/edit/remove exact merchant mappings in Settings. Matching ignores letter case and punctuation; built-in Malaysian merchant rules cover McDonald's, Lotus's, Petronas, TGV and Watsons. Non-MYR receipts require manual conversion outside the scanner. Tax/item-level extraction is not included in this version. Very damaged, skewed or unreadable thermal receipts may require a better photograph or manual entry; confidence checks are conservative heuristics, not a guarantee of OCR accuracy.123124## Appearance125126Settings → **Appearance → Theme** applies Light, Dark or System Default immediately, including dialogs and the app-lock screen. New installations follow the device theme; updates keep the existing choice. Preferences persist in encrypted DataStore without restarting the app.127128## Income, budgets and recurring payments129130Open Settings → **Financial Planning → Monthly Money Planner** to track income and set overall/category monthly budgets using local MYR records. Budget usage comes from actual expenses, including linked refuels. Income is kept separately from expenditure; no account balance is invented.131132Recurring expenses support daily, weekly and monthly schedules. Occurrences and their next-date cursor commit together to prevent duplicates. Monthly schedules keep the original day through shorter months (for example, 31 January → 28/29 February → 31 March). Android can defer background work; local reconciliation catches up when the app next runs. Disabling/deleting a rule preserves existing transactions.133134## Export and encrypted backup135136Settings uses Android's document picker. Choose a private local destination. CSV is an **unencrypted** quoted UTF-8 spreadsheet export with exact MYR amounts and local timestamps; spreadsheet formula-like text is escaped. CSV cannot be restored.137138A complete `.fuelbackup` export includes categories, expenses, refuels, income, budgets, recurring rules, monthly plan snapshots, allocation defaults/overrides, saved journeys, merchant mappings, duplicate fingerprints, preferences and retained receipt photos. Enter and confirm a password of 12–1024 characters. Tink streaming authenticated encryption protects the archive, with PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 (600,000 iterations) and a fresh salt. The password is never stored. **Losing it can make the backup unrecoverable.**139140Restore requires the password and verifies the entire encrypted file, records and images before showing a preview. Confirming replaces the current dataset; export a backup first if needed. Cancel leaves current records unchanged. Older version-1 JSON and version-2 ZIP files have a separate, explicit unencrypted import action. Backups enforce bounded sizes (256 MB expanded, 16 MB metadata, 8 MB per photo) and validate filenames, relationships, odometer order and linked amounts. Staged photos/metadata stay encrypted privately; confirmed photos receive fresh names.141142Automatic cloud backup and device transfer are excluded through Android backup rules. Saving an export to a cloud-synced document provider or sharing it with another app is outside this app's private-storage protection. Keep the backup password separately and test restore before relying on it. Deleting a custom category moves transactions/recurring rules to Others and combines matching category budgets after confirmation. Interrupted settings restoration is retried from a Room-committed intent.143144## Local app lock145146Settings offers optional fingerprint or device-credential authentication, configurable inactivity timeout, and immediate relocking after backgrounding. App windows and dialogs now allow screenshots at the user’s request; this reduces protection against screenshots, recent-app thumbnails and authorized recording tools. Locking still hides and blocks the ledger/dialogs while locked. App lock is independent of encryption and needs no login or connection. Returning from a file picker may require unlocking again; forms remain behind the lock. Actual authentication support depends on the device and enrolled screen lock.147148## Project structure149150```text151app/152  build.gradle.kts                  Android module and dependencies153  schemas/                          Exported Room database schema154  src/main/155    AndroidManifest.xml             Launcher, offline permission and backup policy156    java/my/fuelledger/157      MainActivity.kt               Compose entry point158      LedgerApplication.kt          Application-scoped repository159      LedgerViewModel.kt            Observable UI state and file operations160      domain/Calculations.kt        Money, trip, provisional/full-cycle fuel and spending logic161      data/Database.kt              Room entities, relationships and DAO162      data/LedgerRepository.kt      Transactions and record synchronization163      data/SettingsStore.kt         Encrypted DataStore settings/migration164      data/Backup.kt                Backup validation and CSV escaping165      data/ReceiptBackupArchive.kt  Encrypted complete archives and legacy imports166      receipts/                    Encrypted private photos, bundled OCR and parsing167      security/                    Keystore vault, SQLCipher migration and app lock168      finance/                     Local recurring-payment worker169      ui/                           Screens, editors, charts, theme and receipt review170      ui/ScreenPreviews.kt         Ten dark/light/large-type/empty previews171    res/                            Native launcher icon and base theme172  src/test/                         Host calculation, Room, crypto and Compose tests173  src/androidTest/                  Native encryption/migration and offline OCR tests174buildSrc/                          Reviewed offline OCR telemetry build policy175gradle/wrapper/                     Verified Gradle wrapper176scripts/setup-cloud.sh              Repeatable cloud toolchain setup177build.gradle.kts                   Pinned build plugins178settings.gradle.kts                Standard Google and Maven repositories179```180181The shared fintech design uses navy `#0B1220`, cards `#18263B`, emerald `#4DE0B1`, text `#F3F6FA` and muted text `#94A3B8`, with a complete light palette. Cards/actions stack on narrow phones and at larger font sizes. `FintechTheme.kt` centralizes colours, typography and shapes; `Components.kt` provides reusable cards/charts. Open `ScreenPreviews.kt` in Android Studio for previews without a database or ViewModel.182183The UI reads state through `LedgerViewModel`. Writes go through `LedgerRepository`; Room exposes flows, so adding, editing and deleting records updates dashboards automatically. Heavy database and document operations run off the main thread. Calculation logic is separate from Android and is tested with JUnit. Room integration tests use Robolectric with an actual SQLite database.184185Room is at schema version 5 and exports schemas 1–5. Additive migrations retain existing records and expense links; the encryption upgrade verifies a replacement before replacing a legacy plaintext database. Future database changes must increment the version and implement/test a migration. **Do not add destructive migration fallback**, which would erase records. Appearance and scanner preferences use encrypted DataStore; allocation plans and month overrides use encrypted Room. System Default is the theme for new installations; saved Light/System/Dark choices are retained. Keep the stable application ID `my.fuelledger` for updates.186187In this prepared cloud workspace, use `source /workspace/.tooling/fuel-ledger-env.sh` before running Gradle. To reproduce the full cloud setup, run `bash scripts/setup-cloud.sh` from this project. It downloads checksum-verified build tools outside the checkout, reuses the platform's proxy and certificate trust, accepts SDK licenses and runs the tests, debug build and lint. This script is specifically for the cloud `/workspace` layout; use the Android Studio instructions on your own computer.188189## Versioning and compatible APK releases190191Follow [RELEASING.md](RELEASING.md) and use `scripts/release.py` for a new distribution. It reads the highest verified version/code, checks the original signing identity, runs tests/builds/lint, verifies the actual APK, and advances `version.properties` only after success. [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) and [RELEASES.md](RELEASES.md) retain the verified history. Normal Gradle builds reproduce the recorded version without incrementing it.192193Compatible updates must retain the **existing package and signing certificate** and have a higher code. Do not generate or substitute a new key for an existing installation; that prevents an in-place update. Keep credentials outside Git. The current downloadable build is signed with the original development key. Optimized unsigned release builds compile separately; a distributable optimized APK must be signed with that same key and pass the documented binary checks. Do not uninstall to bypass a mismatch, because uninstalling removes records and Keystore keys.194195## Validation and limitations196197The current refinement passes 306 app host tests, six release-workflow tests, debug/release builds and lint (0 errors). Native offline/security/migration checks and their build provenance are recorded in [VALIDATION.md](VALIDATION.md). Automated checks exercise the specified trip example, exact currency, daily/monthly/category aggregation, timezone and year boundaries, partial fills, edits/deletions, linked expenses, invalid input, CSV and backup restoration.198199This is a personal, single-vehicle, MYR app. It does not include multi-vehicle tracking or CSV import. Release signing requires your own key. Before relying on it for irreplaceable data, verify the app and backup/restore on your phone and keep regular backups. A compiled APK is not a claim of physical-device testing.

1# APK release workflow23The package is always `my.fuelledger`. `version.properties` records the last successfully verified distributable version; Gradle and the launcher label read it. Settings → About → App Version reads PackageManager's installed version rather than a handwritten label. Main-screen headers contain no application version.45Choose Semantic Versioning deliberately: **MAJOR** for significant architectural changes, **MINOR** for new functionality and **PATCH** for fixes/UI refinements. Version 1.5.0 includes the embedded calendar and interactive centred daily chart alongside corrective UI/fuel work. Historical binaries are recorded honestly in [RELEASES.md](RELEASES.md), including reused version codes.67## Create a new distributable build891. Finish and review the source changes, then save a source checkpoint. Preserve the existing database, offline restrictions and certificate.102. Write reviewed release notes with `### New features`, `### Bug fixes` and `### UI improvements`. Use “None” where appropriate.113. Load the installed JDK/SDK environment, then invoke:1213```sh14source /workspace/.tooling/fuel-ledger-env.sh15python -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -v16python scripts/release.py --bump patch --notes path/to/reviewed-notes.md --variant debug17```1819Use `--bump minor` or `--bump major` when the actual scope warrants it. The date defaults to the current Malaysia date; `--date YYYY-MM-DD` can specify a verified release date. This is a development-time command; it adds no runtime networking or app dependency.2021The script first checks the existing Gradle debug signing identity without building or creating a key, then audits actual metadata from existing distribution APKs, chooses a code greater than all known/discovered releases, and builds using temporary Gradle version overrides. It runs the full host suite, builds debug/instrumentation and optimized unsigned release APKs, then runs lint sequentially. The distributable APK must pass embedded package/version checks, signature verification against the original certificate, 16KiB ZIP alignment and the no-network permission policy. Only after success does it create `downloads/FuelExpenseTracker_vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH.apk` and update `version.properties`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `RELEASES.md`, `releases/history.json` and `downloads/SHA256SUMS`. Existing APKs are never overwritten.2223A failed build or failed binary validation leaves the recorded version unchanged. Fix the issue and run the same command again. Ordinary Gradle builds reproduce the current version without incrementing anything. Do not manually publish another changed APK with a reused version/code; use the workflow for each new distribution. After a published release, subsequent source changes require a new semantic bump and a new artifact.2425Review the generated diff, update PROGRESS.md/VALIDATION.md and the README download link, commit the APK and metadata, push the authorized GitHub checkpoint, and verify the public APK's SHA256. Keep old artifacts and dated reports. Machine caches, local databases and signing credentials stay outside Git.2627## Signing and updates2829All recorded historical builds share certificate SHA256:3031`4cb7dbc7bfd1eafb5b37339ddcc875174bf6f35139c0e6d87ba4b0f120c37ae8`3233The current distribution workflow uses `--variant debug`: it preserves that existing development signing identity and explicitly records “Signed debug build.” The optimized release build is also compiled, but remains unsigned and is not the downloadable distribution.3435For an optimized signed distribution, keep the **same private signing key**, build/sign the proposed next version with that key outside Git, then pass `--variant release --signed-apk /private/path/same-key-signed.apk`. The script still builds/tests and verifies the submitted APK's package/version/certificate. It never creates a new signing key or asks for a password in source code. A missing original key blocks compatible distribution; do not substitute a new key or advise uninstalling to bypass a mismatch. New compatible APKs install with `adb install -r` or the system package installer without clearing financial data. Safe Room migrations remain registered.3637No signing key/password is stored in the release ledger. If a public development key is unsuitable for a future production distribution, explain migration and backup implications before changing identity; never silently change it.

1# Offline storage and security23This document describes the 1.2.0 implementation. Actual build/device results belong in `VALIDATION.md`; source inspection alone is not evidence of working security on every phone.45## Local data67- Room preserves the existing categories, expenses, refuels, and settings intent. Schema 1 → 2 adds optional refuel metadata; schema 2 → 3 adds receipt/recurrence references and local income, budgets, and recurring-payment tables. Schema 3 → 4 adds planning snapshots, allocations, journeys, merchant rules, receipt fingerprints, a unique recurring-occurrence index and additive recurrence metadata. No destructive migration is used.8- Production Room opens with maintained SQLCipher. A random database password is wrapped by an AES-256-GCM key generated in Android Keystore. Wrapped keys live under `noBackupFilesDir`; the master key is not exported.9- An existing plaintext database is checkpointed and exported directly to an encrypted temporary database. Integrity, version, tables, and record counts are checked before a same-directory atomic replacement. An encryption failure must preserve the existing records and report an error.10- Settings, lock preferences, and retained receipt copies use the platform AES-GCM primitive with fresh nonces and authenticated file purposes. Settings migration removes old preferences only after committing encrypted replacements.11- Receipt originals remain in their original gallery location. Imported copies are normalized and encrypted in private storage. OCR, previews and image adjustments decrypt into memory. Camera capture delegates to the device camera app using a non-exported, grant-only FileProvider limited to `cache/receipt-capture`; this temporary image is plaintext in private cache until imported and removed. Abandoned captures are cleaned after 24 hours at startup. Persistent imported/retained copies are encrypted. Removing an existing attachment takes effect when its edited transaction is saved. Deleting extracted/new copies must not delete a still-saved reference.12- Production never silently falls back to a plaintext database or resets an unreadable store. JVM tests use an explicitly separate test application with a test key and plaintext Room; that class is not packaged in the application.1314## Offline OCR and dependencies1516The app uses **bundled** `com.google.mlkit:text-recognition:16.0.1`. Its Latin model is packaged in the APK. The application's OCR path never requests a remote model. Google's bundled artifact transitively includes shared `play-services-mlkit-*` code; that name alone does not mean the selected model is downloaded.1718An audit found three Firelog transport sinks and one Play Services telemetry sink in the pinned ML Kit shared code. `buildSrc/.../OfflineMlKitTelemetry.java` removes their transport initialization and dispatch bodies at build time for both debug and release. The `transport-runtime` and `transport-backend-cct` modules are excluded entirely. The small transport **API** interfaces and ML Kit's component/encoder utilities remain for binary compatibility; they are not a Firebase account, database, analytics service, or network backend.1920`verifyOfflineOcrPolicy` verifies that all four reviewed classes/signatures exist in the resolved SDK artifacts and fails if their shapes change. Any ML Kit upgrade requires reviewing this policy and rerunning fresh-install offline recognition. The application manifest also explicitly removes Internet and network-state permissions introduced by dependencies. Final packaged permissions and services must be inspected after each dependency change.2122| Direct runtime dependency | Purpose |23| --- | --- |24| AndroidX Compose / Material 3 / Activity / Lifecycle | Local interface, navigation state, lifecycle, accessibility |25| Room 2.8.5 / SQLite 2.6.2 | Local structured records and migrations |26| SQLCipher Android 4.19.1 | Encrypted SQLite storage |27| DataStore 1.2.1 | Local settings with encrypted serializer |28| ExifInterface 1.4.2 | Correct imported image orientation |29| ML Kit Text Recognition 16.0.1 | Bundled on-device Latin receipt recognition |30| Tink Android 1.23.0 | Maintained streaming authenticated manual-backup encryption |31| Biometric 1.1.0 / Fragment 1.9.1 | Device authentication and credential fallback |32| WorkManager 2.12.0 | Local recurring-payment scheduling; no network constraint |33| Coroutines 1.11.0 / Kotlin serialization 1.11.0 | Local asynchronous work and validated backup data |3435There is no app cloud database, account, advertising SDK, external API client, remote crash reporter, remote AI integration, or app-written network request. Development-time Gradle downloads are separate from installed-app operation.3637## Manual exports and restore3839The complete `.fuelbackup` export uses Tink AES-256-GCM-HKDF streaming authenticated encryption. A fresh 32-byte salt and PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 with 600,000 iterations derive a key from the user's password. The fixed versioned header is authenticated; untrusted files cannot request arbitrary password-derivation cost. All authenticated segments, including the final segment, must be verified before displaying a restore preview.4041Passwords are requested for each operation, not persisted, and character arrays are cleared after use. Lost passwords cannot be recovered. Restore previews use encrypted private staging with bounded metadata/image/expanded-size limits. Records, references, and images are validated before confirmation. Restored photos receive fresh names, preserving existing files if a database restore fails.4243CSV exports and explicitly imported older JSON/ZIP backups are plaintext formats. Choose a local destination deliberately. Saving any export to a cloud-synced document provider, sharing it, or retaining the original gallery photo is outside the app's private-storage protection. The app does not integrate a cloud storage provider.4445## Lock, scheduling, and platform backup4647Optional app lock uses AndroidX BiometricPrompt or the device credential on older supported Android versions. It must relock after configured inactivity and backgrounding while retaining entry state behind protected UI. At the user’s request, application and dialog windows allow normal screenshots (no `FLAG_SECURE`). This reduces protection against device screenshots, recent-app thumbnails and authorized recording tools. App lock still hides and blocks the underlying ledger/dialogs while locked; it does not impose a screenshot restriction. Locking and data encryption are separate controls; local scheduled payments still work without authenticating in a foreground session.4849Recurring payments use local dates/time zones, deterministic occurrence IDs, and transactional record/cursor updates. Reconciliation runs at launch and through local WorkManager work. Android may defer background work; reconciliation catches up when the app runs again.5051`allowBackup=false` and explicit pre-Android-12 backup / Android-12+ cloud-and-device-transfer exclusions cover root, files, databases, preferences, external, and device-protected domains. Android Keystore keys are not included in manual backups; portable backups are instead protected by the separate password. Manufacturer transfer behavior remains a platform limitation requiring device-specific verification.5253## Practical limits5455- This is not protection against an already-compromised/rooted operating system, an unlocked authenticated session, malicious keyboards/accessibility services, or someone who knows the backup password.56- Plaintext legacy data can be removed only after a verified replacement. Flash storage does not provide guaranteed secure erasure of historical blocks.57- Sensitive values and password text can exist transiently in process memory. Clearing mutable buffers reduces retention; it cannot guarantee erasure of every framework/string copy.58- Uninstalling/clearing app data or losing the device Keystore can make local encrypted records unrecoverable. Keep a tested password-encrypted backup and retain its password separately.59- Debug builds are debuggable. The repository's downloadable debug APK is for installation/testing; a distribution release needs an appropriate private signing key kept outside Git.60- Airplane-mode OCR, migration, restart persistence, credential authentication, hardware-backed key storage, recent-app rendering, and device-transfer behavior must only be called verified where an actual test was performed. See `VALIDATION.md` for the precise evidence and remaining limits.6162## Planning and receipt automation in 1.3.06364Allocation percentages, month snapshots and saved journeys are planning records in encrypted Room; none posts actual transactions. Expected income is kept separate from actual income. Confirmed fixed payments link an existing expense or create one occurrence atomically, with a unique `(recurringRuleId, recurringDate)` constraint. Existing automatic recurrence remains supported and consults those same links.6566Receipt auto-save defaults off. A local contrast/sharpness gate and deterministic parsing/validation require review for weak, ambiguous, unsupported-currency, petrol or duplicate candidates. Auto-save additionally verifies the currently stored mode, recognized merchant/amount/date and merchant override inside the save operation. Exact normalized OCR fingerprints are unique; potential semantic duplicates require review. Expense insertion, fingerprint and optional merchant mapping commit in one Room transaction. Undo checks the unchanged transaction before deleting it and its fingerprint. Fingerprints are hashes of normalized OCR text; raw OCR text is not retained in the database. OCR confidence rules cannot guarantee a perfect result.6768The only newly requested runtime permission is `POST_NOTIFICATIONS`, offered on Android 13+ after optional local planning reminders are enabled. There is no camera permission, storage permission, Internet permission, geocoding, toll API or remote categorization. Camera content is shared only with the user-selected device camera app. Gallery/document providers and camera apps are controlled by Android and may have their own privacy behavior outside this app.

 override fun getFilesDir() = File(directory, "files").apply { mkdirs() }43            override fun getNoBackupFilesDir() = File(directory, "no-backup").apply { mkdirs() }44            override fun getCacheDir() = File(directory, "cache").apply { mkdirs() }45        }46        val databaseName = "offline-finance-${UUID.randomUUID()}.db"47        val vault = LocalVault(context)48        val scope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.IO)49        var database: LedgerDatabase? = null50        try {51            val preferences = SettingsStore(context, vault, scope)52            database = LedgerDatabase.open(context, vault, databaseName)53            val ledger = LedgerRepository(database, preferences)54            ledger.initialize()55            val today = LocalDate.now()56            val zone = ZoneId.systemDefault()57            val now = today.atTime(12, 0).atZone(zone).toInstant().toEpochMilli()58            ledger.saveRefuel(Refuel("baseline", now - 86_400_000, 10000.0, 10.0, 2050, false))59            ledger.saveRefuel(Refuel("latest", now, 10500.0, 40.0, 8200, false))60            val receipts = ReceiptStore(context, vault)61            val bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(300, 150, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)62            bitmap.eraseColor(Color.WHITE)63            val photo = ByteArrayOutputStream().use { output ->64                assertTrue(bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 90, output)); output.toByteArray()65            }66            bitmap.recycle()67            val receipt = receipts.saveRestored(photo)68            assertFalse(receipts.file(receipt).readBytes().take(2).toByteArray().contentEquals(photo.take(2).toByteArray()))69            ledger.saveExpense(Expense("food", 1234, "food", now, "Offline private expense", payment = "Card", receiptFile = receipt))70            ledger.saveSettings(AppSettings("2.77", 6.5, "Light", lastExpensePayment = "Card"))71            val finance = FinanceRepository(database)72            finance.saveIncome(FinanceIncome("salary", 250000, now, "Offline private salary"))73            finance.saveBudget(FinanceBudget("budget", YearMonth.from(today).toString(), 50000))74            finance.saveRecurring(FinanceRecurring("bill", "Offline recurring bill", 1000, "bills", "Monthly", today.toString(), today.toString()))75            assertEquals(0, finance.reconcile(today))76            val snapshot = ledger.backup()77            assertEquals(4, snapshot.expenses.size)78            assertEquals(12484L, snapshot.expenses.sumOf { it.cents })79            assertEquals(12.5, fillEstimates(snapshot.refuels.map { it.point() }).single().kmPerLitre, 0.00001)80            assertEquals(250000L, snapshot.incomes.single().cents)81            assertEquals(50000L, snapshot.budgets.single().cents)82            assertEquals(today.plusMonths(1).toString(), snapshot.recurring.single().nextDate)8384            val archive = ReceiptBackupArchive(context, receipts, vault)85            val encrypted = ByteArrayOutputStream().also {86                archive.writeEncrypted(it, snapshot, "offline-test-password-2026".toCharArray())87            }.toByteArray()88            assertFalse(encrypted.toString(Charsets.ISO_8859_1).contains("Offline private salary"))89            archive.readEncrypted(ByteArrayInputStream(encrypted), "offline-test-password-2026".toCharArray()).use { preview ->90                assertEquals(snapshot, preview.backup)91                assertEquals(1, preview.receiptCount)92                val restored = archive.materialize(preview)93                ledger.restore(restored)94                assertArrayEquals(photo, receipts.readPhoto(restored.expenses.single { it.id == "food" }.receiptFile!!))95            }96            assertEquals(AppSettings("2.77", 6.5, "Light", lastExpensePayment = "Card"), preferences.settings.first())97            database.close()98            database = LedgerDatabase.open(context, vault, databaseName)99            assertEquals(4, database.dao().allExpenses().size)100            assertEquals("Card", database.dao().allExpenses().single { it.id == "food" }.payment)101            assertEquals(250000L, database.financeDao().allIncome().single().cents)102            assertEquals(0, FinanceRepository(database).reconcile(today))103            val updatedLedger = LedgerRepository(database, preferences)104            val planner = FinanceRepository(database)105            planner.saveRecurring(FinanceRecurring("expected", "Expected salary", 300000, "", "Monthly", today.withDayOfMonth(1).toString(), today.withDayOfMonth(1).toString(), kind = "Income", manualPayment = true))106            planner.saveRecurring(FinanceRecurring("fixed", "Fixed rent", 95000, "bills", "Monthly", today.withDayOfMonth(1).toString(), today.withDayOfMonth(1).toString(), manualPayment = true))107            planner.saveAllocation(allocationPlan("default", defaultAllocations))108            val due = planner.ensureMonth(YearMonth.from(today)).occurrences().single { it.ruleId == "fixed" }109            planner.markPaid(due, today, 95000)110            planner.markPaid(due, today, 95000)111            assertEquals(1, database.dao().allExpenses().count { it.recurringRuleId == "fixed" })112            JourneyRepository(database).save(savedJourney("journey", JourneyPlan("KL", "Penang", 350.0)))113            updatedLedger.saveSettings(AppSettings(theme = "System", receiptSaveMode = "Smart", lastExpensePayment = "E-wallet"))114            val scanned = my.fuelledger.receipts.parseReceipt("McDonald's\n$today\nGRAND TOTAL RM24.68")115            val expense = Expense("native-scan", 2468, "food", now, "McDonald's", payment = "Not specified")116            val fingerprint = receiptFingerprint(scanned.rawText)117            updatedLedger.saveReceiptExpense(expense, scanned, fingerprint, true, true)118            assertTrue(runCatching { updatedLedger.saveReceiptExpense(expense.copy(id = "duplicate-scan"), scanned, fingerprint, false, true) }.isFailure)119            val complete = updatedLedger.backup()120            archive.readEncrypted(ByteArrayInputStream(ByteArrayOutputStream().also {121                archive.writeEncrypted(it, complete, "Complete offline upgrade backup".toCharArray())122            }.toByteArray()), "Complete offline upgrade backup".toCharArray()).use { preview ->123                assertEquals(complete, preview.backup)124                updatedLedger.restore(archive.materialize(preview))125            }126            assertEquals(1, database.journeyDao().allJourneys().size)127            assertEquals(1, database.receiptAutomationDao().allScans().size)128            assertEquals(1, database.plannerDao().allAllocations().size)129            updatedLedger.undoReceiptExpense(expense)130            assertNull(database.dao().expense(expense.id))131            assertEquals("System", preferences.settings.first().theme)132            assertEquals("E-wallet", preferences.settings.first().lastExpensePayment)133            photo.fill(0); encrypted.fill(0)134        } finally {135            database?.close()136            scope.coroutineContext[Job]?.cancelAndJoin()137            context.deleteDatabase(databaseName)138            directory.deleteRecursively()139        }140    }141142    @Test fun packagedApplicationHasNoNetworkOrPublicStoragePermission() {143        val app = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext<LedgerApplication>()144        @Suppress("DEPRECATION")145        val permissions = app.packageManager.getPackageInfo(app.packageName, PackageManager.GET_PERMISSIONS)146            .requestedPermissions.orEmpty().toSet()147        assertFalse(permissions.contains("android.permission.INTERNET"))148        assertFalse(permissions.contains("android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE"))149        assertFalse(permissions.contains("android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE"))150        assertFalse(permissions.contains("android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE"))151        @Suppress("DEPRECATION")152        val services = app.packageManager.getPackageInfo(app.packageName, PackageManager.GET_SERVICES)153            .services.orEmpty().map { it.name }154        assertFalse(services.any { it.contains("datatransport") || it.contains("firebase.analytics") })155        assertEquals(0, app.applicationInfo.flags and android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo.FLAG_ALLOW_BACKUP)156    }157158    @Test fun bundledReceiptModelRecognizesTextWithoutAnyNetwork() = runBlocking {159        val app = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext<LedgerApplication>()160        assertEquals("Enable airplane mode before fresh-install instrumentation", 1,161            Settings.Global.getInt(app.contentResolver, Settings.Global.AIRPLANE_MODE_ON, 0))162        val bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(1500, 800, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)163        val canvas = Canvas(bitmap)164        canvas.drawColor(Color.WHITE)165        val paint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {166            color = Color.BLACK; textSize = 64f; typeface = Typeface.create(Typeface.MONOSPACE, Typeface.BOLD)167        }168        listOf("SHELL", "RON95 40.00 L", "TOTAL RM 82.00", "15/10/2026 10:30").forEachIndexed { index, text ->169            canvas.drawText(text, 80f, 140f + index * 150f, paint)170        }171        val bytes = ByteArrayOutputStream().use { output ->172            assertTrue(bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 95, output)); output.toByteArray()173        }174        bitmap.recycle()175        try {176            val result = withTimeout(90_000) { ReceiptScanner().scan(bytes) }177            assertEquals("82.00", result.amount)178            assertEquals(0, "40.00".toBigDecimal().compareTo(requireNotNull(result.litres).toBigDecimal()))179            assertEquals("RON95", result.fuelType)180            assertTrue(result.rawText.contains("SHELL"))181        } finally { bytes.fill(0) }182    }183}

recurring-work setup. */24@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)25class ProductionStartupTest {26    @Test fun freshOfflineActivityReachesLedgerAndSurvivesRecreation() = runBlocking {27        // This acceptance check must never modify or inspect an owner's ledger.28        check(Process.myUid() / 100_000 != 0) { "Run startup acceptance in an isolated Android test user." }29        val app = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext<LedgerApplication>()30        assertEquals(1, Settings.Global.getInt(app.contentResolver, Settings.Global.AIRPLANE_MODE_ON, 0))31        val instrumentation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()32        val active = AtomicReference<MainActivity?>()33        val monitor = ActivityLifecycleMonitorRegistry.getInstance()34        val callback = ActivityLifecycleCallback { activity, stage ->35            if (activity is MainActivity && stage == Stage.RESUMED) active.set(activity)36        }37        monitor.addLifecycleCallback(callback)38        try {39            // startActivitySync waits for an idle queue, which an animated loading screen40            // need not provide on slow software emulators. Assert lifecycle and readiness41            // directly instead; neither loading text nor a successful launch is a pass.42            app.startActivity(Intent(app, MainActivity::class.java).addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK))43            val activity = withTimeout(60_000) { while (active.get() == null) delay(50); active.get()!! }44            lateinit var model: LedgerViewModel45            instrumentation.runOnMainSync {46                model = ViewModelProvider(activity)[LedgerViewModel::class.java]47                assertEquals(0, activity.window.attributes.flags and WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_SECURE)48            }49            withTimeout(120_000) { model.ready.first { it } }50            // SQLCipher can open additional observed-query connections after initialization.51            // Keep the same bounded software-emulator budget as the readiness stage.52            val initial = withTimeout(120_000) { model.state.first { it.categories.isNotEmpty() } }53            assertTrue(initial.categories.map { it.id }.containsAll(my.fuelledger.data.defaultCategories.map { it.id }))54            instrumentation.runOnMainSync { activity.recreate() }55            val recreated = withTimeout(60_000) { while (active.get() === activity) delay(50); active.get()!! }56            instrumentation.runOnMainSync { assertSame(model, ViewModelProvider(recreated)[LedgerViewModel::class.java]) }57            assertTrue(model.ready.value)58        } finally {59            monitor.removeLifecycleCallback(callback)60            active.get()?.let { activity -> instrumentation.runOnMainSync { activity.finish() } }61        }62    }63}

put("notes", refuel.notes)217                if (version >= 2) {218                    put("fuelType", refuel.fuelType); put("stationLocation", refuel.stationLocation)219                    put("receiptFile", refuel.receiptFile)220                }221            })222            old.execSQL("INSERT INTO expenses (id, cents, categoryId, timestamp, description, notes, payment, fuelId) runCatching { my.fuelledger.widgets.LedgerWidgets.update(getApplication()) }; runCatching { my.fuelledger.finance.PlannerReminders.update(getApplication(), ledger) } }; done() }33            catch (cancelled: CancellationException) { throw cancelled }34            catch (failure: Exception) { _error.value = failure.message ?: "Unable to save the local financial record." }35            finally { _busy.value = false }36        }37    }38    fun openMonth(month: java.time.YearMonth) {39        viewModelScope.launch {40            try { withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { finance.reconcile(); java.security.SecureRandom16import javax.crypto.SecretKeyFactory17import javax.crypto.spec.PBEKeySpec1819/**20 * Password-derived, segmented authenticated encryption using Google's maintained Tink primitive.21 * Envelope version 1 fixes all algorithms and costs; the complete header is authenticated AAD.22 * Callers must consume decrypting streams through EOF before accepting any restored records.23 */24internal object BackupCrypto {25    private val magic = "FUELBKUP".toByteArray(Charsets.US_ASCII)26    private const val VERSION = 127    private const val ALGORITHM = 1 // PBKDF2-SHA256 + AES256-GCM-HKDF-SHA256 streaming, 64 KiB segments.28    private const val ITERATIONS = 600_00029    private const val SALT_BYTES = 3230    private const val HEADER_BYTES = 8 + 1 + 1 + 4 + SALT_BYTES31    private const val SEGMENT_BYTES = 64 * 102432    private val parameters = AesGcmHkdfStreamingParameters.builder()33        .setKeySizeBytes(32)34        .setDerivedAesGcmKeySizeBytes(32)35        .setHkdfHashType(AesGcmHkdfStreamingParameters.HashType.SHA256)36        .setCiphertextSegmentSizeBytes(SEGMENT_BYTES)37        .build()3839    fun encryptingStream(output: OutputStream, password: CharArray): OutputStream {40        require(password.size in 12..1024) { "Use a backup password containing 12–1024 characters." }41        val salt = ByteArray(SALT_BYTES).also { SecureRandom().nextBytes(it) }42        val header = ByteArrayOutputStream(HEADER_BYTES).also { bytes ->43            DataOutputStream(bytes).apply {44                write(magic)45                writeByte(VERSION)46                writeByte(ALGORITHM)47                writeInt(ITERATIONS)48                write(salt)49            }50        }.toByteArray()51        val primitive = primitive(password, salt)52        output.write(header)53        return primitive.newEncryptingStream(output, header)54    }5556    fun decryptingStream(input: InputStream, password: CharArray): InputStream {57        require(password.size in 1..1024) { "Enter the backup password." }58        val header = ByteArray(HEADER_BYTES)59        DataInputStream(input).readFully(header)60        val data = DataInputStream(ByteArrayInputStream(header))61        val prefix = ByteArray(magic.size).also { data.readFully(it) }62        require(prefix.contentEquals(magic)) { "This is not an == month }.sumOf { it.cents }101102fun financeBudgetSpending(budget: FinanceBudget, expenses: List<Expense>, zone: ZoneId = ZoneId.systemDefault()): Long =103    expenses.filter { YearMonth.from(Instant.ofEpochMilli(it.timestamp).atZone(zone)).toString() == budget.month &&104        (budget.categoryId.isEmpty() || it.categoryId == budget.categoryId) }.sumOf { it.cents }
