1package my.fuelledger.data23import androidx.room.withTransaction4import my.fuelledger.domain.MAX_CENTS5import java.time.*67class FinanceRepository(private val database: LedgerDatabase) {8    val dao = database.financeDao()9    val income = dao.income()10    val budgets = dao.budgets()11    val recurring = dao.recurring()1213    suspend fun saveIncome(value: FinanceIncome) { validateFinanceIncome(value); dao.putIncome(value) }14    suspend fun deleteIncome(id: String) = dao.deleteIncome(id)15    suspend fun saveBudget(value: FinanceBudget) = database.withTransaction {16        validateFinanceBudget(value)17        requireCategory(value.categoryId, allowOverall = true)18        require(dao.allBudgets().none { it.id != value.id && it.month == value.month && it.categoryId == value.categoryId }) {19            "This month already has a budget for that category. Edit its existing budget."20        }21        dao.putBudget(value)22    }23    suspend fun deleteBudget(id: String) = dao.deleteBudget(id)24    suspend fun saveRecurring(value: FinanceRecurring) = database.withTransaction {25        validateFinanceRecurring(value)26        if (value.kind == "Expense") requireCategory(value.categoryId)27        preserveCurrentPlan()28        dao.putRecurring(value)29        refreshCurrentPlan()30        reconcile()31    }32    suspend fun deleteRecurring(id: String) = database.withTransaction {33        preserveCurrentPlan(); dao.deleteRecurring(id); refreshCurrentPlan()34    }35    private suspend fun preserveCurrentPlan() { ensureMonth(YearMonth.now()) }36    private suspend fun refreshCurrentPlan() { database.plannerDao().putMonth(makeFinanceMonth(YearMonth.now(), dao.allRecurring())) }37    suspend fun ensureMonth(month: YearMonth): FinanceMonth = database.withTransaction {38        require(validPlannerMonth(month.toString()))39        val saved = database.plannerDao().allMonths().firstOrNull { it.month == month.toString() }40        if (saved != null && month < YearMonth.now()) saved41        else makeFinanceMonth(month, dao.allRecurring()).also { if (month <= YearMonth.now()) database.plannerDao().putMonth(it) }42    }43    suspend fun saveAllocation(value: AllocationPlan) = database.withTransaction {44        validateAllocationPlan(value)45        val categoryIds = database.dao().allCategories().map { it.id }.toSet()46        require(value.categories().flatMap { it.categoryIds }.all { it in categoryIds }) { "A spending category no longer exists." }47        if (value.scope == "default") freezePastAllocations()48        database.plannerDao().putAllocation(value)49    }50    private suspend fun freezePastAllocations() {51        val planner = database.plannerDao()52        val allocations = planner.allAllocations()53        val defaults = allocations.firstOrNull { it.scope == "default" }?.categories() ?: defaultAllocations54        for (month in planner.allMonths().filter { YearMonth.parse(it.month) < YearMonth.now() }) {55            if (allocations.none { it.scope == month.month }) planner.putAllocation(allocationPlan(month.month, defaults))56        }57    }58    suspend fun resetAllocation(scope: String) = database.plannerDao().deleteAllocation(scope)59    /** Existing occurrence links win even if a daily expense was entered separately. */60    suspend fun markPaid(occurrence: PlannedOccurrence, paidDate: LocalDate, cents: Long,61        existingExpenseId: String? = null, zone: ZoneId = ZoneId.systemDefault()) = database.withTransaction {62        val planned = ensureMonth(YearMonth.from(LocalDate.parse(occurrence.date))).occurrences()63            .firstOrNull { it.ruleId == occurrence.ruleId && it.date == occurrence.date && it.kind == "Expense" }64        require(planned != null) { "This payment is no longer planned. Refresh the planner." }65        val expenses = database.dao().allExpenses()66        val linked = expenses.firstOrNull { it.recurringRuleId == occurrence.ruleId && it.recurringDate == occurrence.date }67        if (existingExpenseId == null && linked != null) return@withTransaction68        require(linked == null || linked.id == existingExpenseId) { "This payment already has a linked expense." }69        if (existingExpenseId != null) {70            val existing = requireNotNull(database.dao().expense(existingExpenseId)) { "Expense no longer exists." }71            require(existing.kind == "Expense") { "A refund cannot pay a fixed commitment." }72            require(existing.fuelId == null && (existing.recurringRuleId == null || existing.id == linked?.id)) { "Expense already belongs to another payment." }73            val updated = existing.copy(recurringRuleId = occurrence.ruleId, recurringDate = occurrence.date)74            validateExpense(updated)75            database.dao().putExpense(updated)76        } else {77            val category = if (database.dao().allCategories().any { it.id == planned.categoryId }) planned.categoryId else OTHER_CATEGORY78            val value = Expense("recurring:${occurrence.ruleId}:${occurrence.date}", cents, category,79                paidDate.atTime(12, 0).atZone(zone).toInstant().toEpochMilli(), planned.name, payment = planned.payment,80                recurringRuleId = planned.ruleId, recurringDate = planned.date)81            validateExpense(value); requireCategory(value.categoryId)82            require(database.dao().expense(value.id) == null) { "A transaction ID conflicts with this payment." }83            database.dao().putExpense(value)84        }85    }8687    private suspend fun requireCategory(id: String, allowOverall: Boolean = false) {88        require((allowOverall && id.isEmpty()) || database.dao().allCategories().any { it.id == id }) { "Category no longer exists." }89    }9091    /** Both the occurrence and cursor commit together. Repeated launches/work runs cannot duplicate payments. */92    suspend fun reconcile(today: LocalDate? = null, zone: ZoneId = ZoneId.systemDefault()): Int = database.withTransaction {93        val through = today ?: LocalDate.now(zone)94        var inserted = 095        for (rule in dao.allRecurring().filter { it.enabled && it.kind == "Expense" && !it.manualPayment }) {96            validateFinanceRecurring(rule)97            requireCategory(rule.categoryId)98            val anchor = LocalDate.parse(rule.startDate)99            var due = LocalDate.parse(rule.nextDate)100            var occurrences = 0101            // Bound one background run while retaining its cursor for the following run.102            while (due <= through && (rule.endDate == null || due <= LocalDate.parse(rule.endDate)) && occurrences < 36_600) {103                val expense = Expense(id = "recurring:${rule.id}:$due", cents = rule.cents, categoryId = rule.categoryId,104                    timestamp = due.atStartOfDay(zone).toInstant().toEpochMilli(), description = rule.name,105                    notes = rule.notes, payment = rule.payment, recurringRuleId = rule.id, recurringDate = due.toString())106                validateExpense(expense)107                val alreadyLinked = database.dao().occurrence(rule.id, due.toString())108                if (alreadyLinked != null) { /* A manually linked transaction already pays this occurrence. */ }109                else if (dao.insertOccurrence(expense) != -1L) inserted++110                else {111                    val existing = database.dao().expense(expense.id)112                    require(existing != null && existing.recurringRuleId == rule.id && existing.recurringDate == due.toString()) {113                        "A transaction conflicts with this recurring payment. No scheduled payments were changed."114                    }115                }116                due = nextFinanceOccurrence(anchor, due, rule.frequency)117                occurrences++118            }119            if (due.toString() != rule.nextDate) dao.putRecurring(rule.copy(nextDate = due.toString()))120        }121        val lastSaved = database.plannerDao().allMonths().maxByOrNull { it.month }?.month?.let(YearMonth::parse)122        val target = YearMonth.from(through)123        if (lastSaved != null && lastSaved < target) {124            var missed = lastSaved.plusMonths(1)125            while (missed < target) { ensureMonth(missed); missed = missed.plusMonths(1) }126        }127        freezePastAllocations()128        ensureMonth(target)129        inserted130    }131132    /** Call inside the category deletion transaction. Colliding budgets are combined without losing planned amounts. */133    suspend fun reassignCategory(oldId: String, replacement: String) = database.withTransaction {134        if (oldId == replacement) return@withTransaction135        requireCategory(replacement)136        dao.reassignRecurringCategory(oldId, replacement)137        // Removed categories become unmapped instead of creating overlapping allocations.138        for (plan in database.plannerDao().allAllocations()) {139            database.plannerDao().putAllocation(allocationPlan(plan.scope, plan.categories().map { it.copy(categoryIds = it.categoryIds - oldId) }))140        }141        for (budget in dao.allBudgets().filter { it.categoryId == oldId }) {142            val target = dao.allBudgets().firstOrNull { it.month == budget.month && it.categoryId == replacement }143            if (target == null) dao.putBudget(budget.copy(categoryId = replacement))144            else {145                val combined = Math.addExact(target.cents, budget.cents)146                require(combined <= MAX_CENTS) { "Combined category budgets exceed the supported amount. Edit them before deleting this category." }147                dao.deleteBudget(budget.id)148                dao.putBudget(target.copy(cents = combined))149            }150        }151    }152}

Preferences could not be applied yet; retry or reopen the app to finish restoring settings.", cause)1617class LedgerRepository(val database: LedgerDatabase, val preferences: PreferencesStore) {18    val dao = database.dao()19    val categories = dao.categories()20    val expenses = dao.expenses()21    val refuels = dao.refuels()22    private val writes = Mutex()2324    suspend fun initialize() = writes.withLock {25        database.withTransaction {26            val existing = dao.allCategories().map { it.id }.toSet()27            defaultCategories.filter { it.id !in existing }.forEach { dao.putCategory(it) }28        }29        applyPendingSettings()30    }31    private suspend fun applyPendingSettings() {32        dao.pendingSettings()?.let {33            preferences.save(backupJson.decodeFromString<AppSettings>(it.payload))34            dao.clearPendingSettings()35        }36    }37    suspend fun saveExpense(expense: Expense) = writes.withLock {38        validateExpense(expense)39        require(expense.fuelId == null) { "Edit linked expenses through the refuel record." }40        database.withTransaction {41            val existing = dao.expense(expense.id)42            require(existing?.fuelId == null) { "Edit linked expenses through the refuel record." }43            require(dao.allCategories().any { it.id == expense.categoryId }) { "Category no longer exists." }44            val updated = if (existing?.recurringRuleId != null) expense.copy(45                recurringRuleId = existing.recurringRuleId, recurringDate = existing.recurringDate) else expense46            validateExpense(updated)47            if (updated.kind == "Refund" && updated.refundOf != null) {48                val original = dao.expense(updated.refundOf)49                if (original == null) require(existing?.kind == "Refund" && existing.refundOf == updated.refundOf) { "Original expense no longer exists. && categories.map { it.id }.distinct().size == categories.size) { "Use 1–50 unique allocation categories." }38    require(categories.all { it.id.isNotBlank() && it.id.length <= 64 && it.name.isNotBlank() && it.name.length <= 100 && it.basisPoints in 0..10000 && it.categoryIds.size <= 500 && it.categoryIds.all { id -> id.isNotBlank() && id.length <= 100 } && (!it.savings || require(categories.sumOf { it.basisPoints } == 10000) { "Total allocation must equal 100%." }41    val mapped = categories.flatMap { it.categoryIds }42    require(mapped.distinct().size == mapped.size) { "Each spending category can belong to only one allocation." }43}44fun validPlannerMonth(text: String) = runCatching { YearMonth.parse(text).let { it.year in 1970..2999 && it.toString() == text } }.getOrDefault(false)45fun validateFinanceMonth(value: FinanceMonth) {46    require(validPlannerMonth(value.month)) { "Invalid planner month." }47    val occurrences = value.occurrences()48    require(occurrences.size <= 100000 && occurrences.map { it.ruleId to it.date }.distinct().size == occurrences.size) { "Duplicate or excessive planned payments." }49    occurrences.forEach {50        require(it.ruleId.isNotBlank() && it.ruleId.length <= 64 && YearMonth.from(LocalDate.parse(it.date)).toString() == value.month && it.name.isNotBlank() && it.name.length <= 200 && it.cents in The posting cursor never alters the plan. */54fun plannedOccurrences(rules: List<FinanceRecurring>, month: YearMonth): List<PlannedOccurrence> = rules.filter { it.enabled && it.cents > 0 }.flatMap { rule ->55    validateFinanceRecurring(rule)56    val anchor = LocalDate.parse(rule.startDate)57    val first = month.atDay(1)58    val last = minOf(month.atEndOfMonth(), rule.endDate?.let(LocalDate::parse) ?: month.atEndOfMonth())59    var due = when (rule.frequency) {60        "Monthly" -> month.atDay(minOf(anchor.dayOfMonth, month.lengthOfMonth()))61        "Weekly" -> anchor.plusWeeks(maxOf(0, ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(anchor, first) / 7))62        else -> maxOf(anchor, first)63    }64    buildList {65        while (due <= last) {66            if (due >= anchor && due >= first) add(PlannedOccurrence(rule.id, due.toString(), rule.name, rule.cents, rule.categoryId, rule.kind, rule.payment))67            due = nextFinanceOccurrence(anchor, due, rule.frequency)68        }69    }70}71fun makeFinanceMonth(month: YearMonth, rules: List<FinanceRecurring>) = FinanceMonth(month.toString(), backupJson.encodeToString(plannedOccurrences(rules, month)))7273fun variableExpensesForMonth(month: YearMonth, occurrences: List<PlannedOccurrence>, expenses: List<Expense>, zone: ZoneId): List<Expense> {74    val reserved = occurrences.filter { it.kind == "Expense" }.map { it.ruleId to it.date }.toSet()75    val fixedIds = expenses.filter { (it.recurringRuleId to it.recurringDate) in reserved }.map { it.id }.toSet()76    return expenses.filter { YearMonth.from(Instant.ofEpochMilli(it.timestamp).atZone(zone)) == month &&77        (it.recurringRuleId == null || (it.recurringRuleId to it.recurringDate) !in reserved) &&78        !(it.kind == "Refund" && it.refundOf in fixedIds) }79}80data class MonthlyMoney(val expected: Long, val fixed: Long, val actualIncome: Long, val actualExpenses: Long,81    val variableExpenses: Long) {82    val plannedAvailable get() = expected - 1package my.fuelledger.data23import java.time.*4import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter56/** Stable across query order, process restart, category edits and backup restore. */7fun displayCategories(categories: List<Category>): List<Category> {8    val builtins = listOf("food", "groceries", "entertainment", "shopping", FUEL_CATEGORY, "bills")9    return categories.sortedWith(compareBy<Category> { if (it.id == OTHER_CATEGORY) 2 else if (it.id in builtins) 0 else 1 }10        .thenBy { builtins.indexOf(it.id).let { index -> if (index < 0) Int.MAX_VALUE else index } }11        .thenBy { it.name.lowercase(java.util.Locale.ROOT) }.thenBy { it.id })12}13fun fuelSpendingMonths(refuels: List<Refuel>, today: LocalDate, count: Int,14    zone: ZoneId = ZoneId.systemDefault()): List<Pair<String, Long>> {15    require(count in listOf(3, 6, 12))16    val current = YearMonth.from(today)17    val amounts = refuels.groupBy { YearMonth.from(Instant.ofEpochMilli(it.timestamp).atZone(zone)) }.mapValues { (_, values) -> values.sumOf { it.cents } }18    val labels = DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("MMM yy", java.util.Locale.ENGLISH)19    return (count - 1 downTo 0).map { offset -> current.minusMonths(offset.toLong()).let { it.format(labels) to (amounts[it] ?: 0L) } }20}21val incomeSourceTypes = listOf("Salary", "Allowance", "Stock / Investment Income", "Passive Income", "Part-Time Income", "Other Income")22fun incomeSourceType(rule: FinanceRecurring): String = rule.categoryId.removePrefix("income:").takeIf { it in incomeSourceTypes } ?: "Other Income"2324fun flexibleAllocationId(categories: List<AllocationCategory>): String =25    categories.firstOrNull { it.remainder }?.id ?: categories.last().id26/** Only the chosen category and the visible remainder change. */27fun moveAllocation(categories: List<AllocationCategory>, id: String, requested: Int): List<AllocationCategory> {28    require(categories.isNotEmpty() && categories.sumOf { it.basisPoints } == 10000 && categories.all { it.basisPoints in 0..10000 })29    val flexible = flexibleAllocationId(categories)30    if (id == flexible) return categories31    val selected = requireNotNull(categories.find { it.id == id })32    val remainder = categories.first { it.id == flexible }33    val target = requested.coerceIn(0, selected.basisPoints + remainder.basisPoints)34    val delta = target - selected.basisPoints35    return categories.map { when (it.id) { id -> it.copy(basisPoints = target); flexible -> it.copy(basisPoints = it.basisPoints - delta); else -> it } }36}37fun removeAllocation(categories: List<AllocationCategory>, id: String): List<AllocationCategory> {38    val flexible = flexibleAllocationId(categories)39    require(id != flexible) { "Choose another flexible category before removing this one." }40    val removed = requireNotNull(categories.find { it.id == id })41    return categories.filterNot { it.id == id }.map { if (it.id == flexible) it.copy(basisPoints = it.basisPoints + removed.basisPoints) else it }42}

1package my.fuelledger.domain23import my.fuelledger.data.*45/** Two recent estimates against at least two earlier estimates, with non-overlapping baselines. */6data class ConsumptionChange(val historical: Double, val recent: Double) {7    val percent get() = (recent - historical) / historical * 1008}9fun consumptionChange(points: List<FuelPoint>): ConsumptionChange? {10    val cycles = fillEstimates(points)11    if (cycles.size < 4) return null12    fun average(values: List<FillEstimate>) = values.sumOf { it.litres } / values.sumOf { it.distance } * 10013    return ConsumptionChange(average(cycles.dropLast(2)), average(cycles.takeLast(2)))14}15data class VehicleCoverage(val start: Long, val end: Long, val distance: Double, val fuelCents: Long,16    val operatingCents: Long, val categoryIds: Set<String>) {17    val fuelRmPerKm get() = fuelCents / 100.0 / distance18    val recordedRmPerKm get() = operatingCents / 100.0 / distance19}20fun vehicleCoverage(refuels: List<Refuel>, expenses: List<Expense>, categories: List<Category>): VehicleCoverage? {21    val cycles = fillEstimates(refuels.map { it.point() })22    if (cycles.isEmpty()) return null23    val byId = refuels.associateBy { it.id }24    val ids = categories.filter { it.id == FUEL_CATEGORY || it.name.lowercase() in setOf("parking", "tolls", "vehicle", "transport") }.map { it.id }.toSet()25    // Include manual recorded transport costs only within included odometer intervals. Linked refuels26    // are already represented by cycle payments; baseline purchases are never counted twice.27    val extras = expenses.filter { it.fuelId == null && it.categoryId in ids && cycles.any { c ->28        it.timestamp > byId.getValue(c.startId).timestamp && it.timestamp <= byId.getValue(c.endId).timestamp29    } }.sumOf { it.cents }30    val fuel = cycles.sumOf { it.cents }31    return VehicleCoverage(byId.getValue(cycles.first().startId).timestamp, byId.getValue(cycles.last().endId).timestamp,32        cycles.sumOf { it.distance }, fuel, fuel + extras, ids)33}34fun averageFuelPrice(refuels: List<Refuel>): Double? = refuels.takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }?.let { values -> values.sumOf { it.cents } / 100.0 / values.sumOf { it.litres } }3536data class FuelCostDrivers(val priceRmPerKm: Double, val consumptionRmPerKm: Double, val totalChangeRmPerKm: Double)37fun fuelCostDrivers(points: List<FuelPoint>): FuelCostDrivers? {38    val cycles = fillEstimates(points)39    if (cycles.size < 4) return null40    val prior = cycles.dropLast(2); val recent = cycles.takeLast(2)41    val priorPrice = prior.sumOf { it.cents } / 100.0 / prior.sumOf { it.litres }42    val recentPrice = recent.sumOf { it.cents } / 100.0 / recent.sumOf { it.litres }43    val priorUse = prior.sumOf { it.litres } / prior.sumOf { it.distance }44    val recentUse = recent.sumOf { it.litres } / recent.sumOf { it.distance }45    return FuelCostDrivers((recentPrice - priorPrice) * priorUse, (recentUse - priorUse) * recentPrice,46        recentUse * recentPrice - priorUse * priorPrice)47}

1package my.fuelledger.finance23import android.Manifest4import android.app.*5import android.content.Context6import android.content.Intent7import android.content.pm.PackageManager8import android.os.Build9import androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat10import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.first11import my.fuelledger.MainActivity12import my.fuelledger.R13import my.fuelledger.data.*14import java.time.*1516/** Optional, on-device reminders. Lock-screen text contains no financial details. */17object PlannerReminders {18    private const val CHANNEL = "local-monthly-planning"19    suspend fun update(context: Context, ledger: LedgerRepository) {20        val manager = context.getSystemService(NotificationManager::class.java)21        val settings = ledger.preferences.settings.first()22        if (!settings.plannerReminders) { manager.cancel(2101); manager.cancel(2102); manager.cancel(2103); return }23        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33 && context.checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS) != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) return24        if (!manager.areNotificationsEnabled()) return25        manager.createNotificationChannel(NotificationChannel(CHANNEL, "Financial planning reminders", NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_DEFAULT))26        val today = LocalDate.now()27        val finance = FinanceRepository(ledger.database)28        val month = finance.ensureMonth(YearMonth.from(today))29        val next = finance.ensureMonth(YearMonth.from(today.plusDays(3)))30        val expenses = ledger.dao.allExpenses()31        val unpaid = (month.occurrences() + next.occurrences()).distinctBy { it.ruleId to it.date }.filter { due ->32            due.kind == "Expense" && LocalDate.parse(due.date) <= today.plusDays(3) &&33                expenses.none { it.recurringRuleId == due.ruleId && it.recurringDate == due.date }34        }35        val intent = PendingIntent.getActivity(context, 21, Intent(context, MainActivity::class.java), PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE)36        fun post(id: Int, title: String, text: String) {37            manager.notify(id, NotificationCompat.Builder(context, CHANNEL).setSmallIcon(R.drawable.symbol_account_balance_wallet)38                .setContentTitle(title).setContentText(text).setContentIntent(intent).setAutoCancel(true)39                .setOnlyAlertOnce(true).setVisibility(NotificationCompat.VISIBILITY_PRIVATE).build())40        }41        if (unpaid.isNotEmpty()) post(2101, "Review your fixed payments", "You have upcoming or unpaid commitments. Open your monthly planner to review.") else manager.cancel(2101)42        val budgets = ledger.database.financeDao().allBudgets().filter { it.month == YearMonth.from(today).toString() }43        if (budgets.any { financeBudgetSpending(it, expenses) >= it.cents * .9 }) post(2103, "Review your budgets", "A monthly budget has reached its alert threshold. Open the app for details.") else manager.cancel(2103)44        val money = monthlyMoney(YearMonth.from(today), month.occurrences(), emptyList(), emptyList())45        if (money.plannedAvailable < 0) post(2102, "Review your monthly plan", "Your fixed commitments exceed expected income. Open the app to adjust your plan.") else manager.cancel(2102)46    }47}

1package my.fuelledger.finance23import android.content.Context4import androidx.work.*5import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException6import my.fuelledger.LedgerApplication7import my.fuelledger.data.FinanceRepository8import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit910/** WorkManager persists this local schedule across process death and supported device reboots. */11class RecurringWorker(context: Context, parameters: WorkerParameters) : CoroutineWorker(context, parameters) {12    override suspend fun doWork(): Result = try {13        val ledger = (applicationContext as LedgerApplication).repository14        ledger.initialize()15        FinanceRepository(ledger.database).reconcile()16        PlannerReminders.update(applicationContext, ledger)17        my.fuelledger.widgets.LedgerWidgets.update(applicationContext)18        java.io.File(applicationContext.cacheDir, "local-exports").listFiles().orEmpty().filter { System.currentTimeMillis() - it.lastModified() > 86_400_000L }.forEach { it.delete() }19        Result.success()20    } catch (cancelled: CancellationException) { throw cancelled }21    catch (_: Exception) { Result.retry() }2223    companion object {24        fun schedule(context: Context) {25            val request = PeriodicWorkRequestBuilder<RecurringWorker>(12, TimeUnit.HOURS)26                .setConstraints(Constraints.Builder().setRequiredNetworkType(NetworkType.NOT_REQUIRED).build()).build()27            WorkManager.getInstance(context).enqueueUniquePeriodicWork("local-recurring-expenses", ExistingPeriodicWorkPolicy.KEEP, request)28        }29    }30}

1package my.fuelledger.receipts23import android.graphics.BitmapFactory4import com.google.mlkit.vision.common.InputImage5import com.google.mlkit.vision.text.TextRecognition6import com.google.mlkit.vision.text.latin.TextRecognizerOptions7import java.io.IOException8import java.util.concurrent.Executor9import kotlin.coroutines.resume10import kotlin.coroutines.resumeWithException11import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers12import kotlinx.coroutines.suspendCancellableCoroutine13import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext1415/** Uses the bundled Latin model locally; scanning does not require network access. */16class ReceiptScanner {17    suspend fun scan(bytes: ByteArray): ReceiptSuggestions = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {18        require(bytes.size in 1..8 * 1024 * 1024) { "The receipt photo is unavailable or too large" }19        val bounds = BitmapFactory.Options().apply { inJustDecodeBounds = true }20        BitmapFactory.decodeByteArray(bytes, 0, bytes.size, bounds)21        require(bounds.outWidth > 0 && bounds.outHeight > 0 && bounds.outWidth.toLong() * bounds.outHeight <= 150_000_000L) {22            "The receipt is not a supported image"23        }24        var sample = 125        while (maxOf(bounds.outWidth, bounds.outHeight) / sample > 4096 ||26            (bounds.outWidth / sample).toLong() * (bounds.outHeight / sample) > 4096L * 1600) sample *= 227        val bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeByteArray(bytes, 0, bytes.size, BitmapFactory.Options().apply { inSampleSize = sample })28            ?: throw IOException("Cannot read the receipt photo")29        val qualityIssue = receiptImageQualityIssue(bitmap)30        val recognizer = try { TextRecognition.getClient(TextRecognizerOptions.DEFAULT_OPTIONS) }31        catch (error: Throwable) { bitmap.recycle(); throw error }32        val recognized = suspendCancellableCoroutine<String> { continuation ->33            try {34                // Keep image resources alive until ML Kit has finished, even if the UI cancels.35                recognizer.process(InputImage.fromBitmap(bitmap, 0)).addOnCompleteListener(DIRECT_EXECUTOR) { task ->36                    recognizer.close()37                    bitmap.recycle()38                    if (continuation.isActive) {39                        if (task.isSuccessful) continuation.resume(task.result.text)40                        else continuation.resumeWithException(task.exception ?: IOException("Receipt scanning failed"))41                    }42                }43            } catch (error: Throwable) {44                recognizer.close()45                bitmap.recycle()46                if (continuation.isActive) continuation.resumeWithException(error)47            }48        }49        parseReceipt(recognized).copy(imageQualityIssue = qualityIssue)50    }5152    private companion object { val DIRECT_EXECUTOR = Executor { it.run() } }53}5455/** A conservative local contrast/sharpness gate. Weak images still produce editable review suggestions. */56internal fun receiptImageQualityIssue(bitmap: android.graphics.Bitmap): String? {57    if (minOf(bitmap.width, bitmap.height) < 240) return "The image is too small for reliable automatic saving. Review or retake it."58    val step = maxOf(2, maxOf(bitmap.width, bitmap.height) / 400)59    fun grey(x: Int, y: Int): Int {60        val pixel = bitmap.getPixel(x, y)61        return (android.graphics.Color.red(pixel) * 30 + android.graphics.Color.green(pixel) * 59 + android.graphics.Color.blue(pixel) * 11) / 10062    }63    var low = 255; var high = 0; var sharpness = 0.0; var samples = 064    for (y in 1 until bitmap.height - 1 step step) for (x in 1 until bitmap.width - 1 step step) {65        val centre = grey(x, y); low = minOf(low, centre); high = maxOf(high, centre)66        val laplacian = grey(x - 1, y) + grey(x + 1, y) + grey(x, y - 1) + grey(x, y + 1) - 4 * centre67        sharpness += laplacian.toDouble() * laplacian; samples++68    }69    return if (high - low < 50 || samples == 0 || sharpness / samples < 25) "The image may be blurred or poorly lit. Review the extracted values or retake it." else null70}

1package my.fuelledger.security23import android.content.Context4import android.security.keystore.KeyGenParameterSpec5import android.security.keystore.KeyProperties6import java.io.IOException7import java.security.KeyStore8import javax.crypto.Cipher9import javax.crypto.KeyGenerator10import javax.crypto.SecretKey11import javax.crypto.spec.GCMParameterSpec1213/** Android's AES-GCM primitive, with a non-exportable Android Keystore master key. */14class LocalVault(private val keyProvider: () -> SecretKey) {15    constructor(context: Context) : this({ androidKey(context.applicationContext.packageName) })1617    fun encrypt(bytes: ByteArray, purpose: String): ByteArray {18        val aad = purposeBytes(purpose)19        val cipher = Cipher.getInstance("AES/GCM/NoPadding")20        // Android Keystore supplies a fresh cryptographically random nonce for every encryption.21        cipher.init(Cipher.ENCRYPT_MODE, keyProvider())22        check(cipher.iv.size == NONCE_SIZE) { "Unsupported encryption nonce." }23        cipher.updateAAD(MAGIC)24        cipher.updateAAD(aad)25        return MAGIC + cipher.iv + cipher.doFinal(bytes)26    }2728    fun decrypt(bytes: ByteArray, purpose: String): ByteArray {29        val aad = purposeBytes(purpose)30        if (bytes.size < MAGIC.size + NONCE_SIZE + TAG_SIZE ||31            !bytes.copyOfRange(0, MAGIC.size).contentEquals(MAGIC)) {32            throw IOException("Unsupported encrypted local file.")33        }34        val nonce = bytes.copyOfRange(MAGIC.size, MAGIC.size + NONCE_SIZE)35        val cipher = Cipher.getInstance("AES/GCM/NoPadding")36        cipher.init(Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE, keyProvider(), GCMParameterSpec(TAG_SIZE * 8, nonce))37        cipher.updateAAD(MAGIC)38        cipher.updateAAD(aad)39        return cipher.doFinal(bytes, MAGIC.size + NONCE_SIZE, bytes.size - MAGIC.size - NONCE_SIZE)40    }4142    private fun purposeBytes(purpose: String): ByteArray {43        require(purpose.isNotBlank() && purpose.length <= 500) { "Encryption purpose is required." }44        return purpose.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)45    }4647    companion object {48        private val MAGIC = byteArrayOf(0x46, 0x4c, 0x56, 0x41, 0x55, 0x4c, 0x54, 1)49        private const val NONCE_SIZE = 1250        private const val TAG_SIZE = 1651        private val keyLock = Any()5253        private fun androidKey(packageName: String): SecretKey = synchronized(keyLock) {54            val alias = "$packageName.local-vault.v1"55            val store = KeyStore.getInstance("AndroidKeyStore").apply { load(null) }56            (store.getKey(alias, null) as? 1package my.fuelledger.ui23import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme4import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column5import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Arrangement6import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp7import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable8import my.fuelledger.FinanceState9import my.fuelledger.LedgerState10import my.fuelledger.data.*11import my.fuelledger.domain.*12import java.time.*1314@Composable fun FinancialAnalysisDetails(state: LedgerState, finance: FinanceState, month: YearMonth,15    start: LocalDate, end: LocalDate, today: LocalDate, zone: ZoneId) {16    Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp)) {17    val report = financialReport(state, finance, start, end, zone)18    LedgerCard {19        Text("Actual financial activity", style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium)20        Text("Income ${Money.format(report.income)} · net expenditure ${Money.format(report.expenses)}")21        Text("Paid fixed ${Money.format(report.fixedPaid)} · variable ${Money.format(report.variable)}")22        Text("Net cash flow ${Money.format(report.net)}", style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium)23    }24    SpendingBars("Income vs Expenses", listOf("Actual income" to report.income, "Net expenses" to report.expenses))25    val months = generateSequence(YearMonth.from(start)) { it.plusMonths(1) }.takeWhile { it <= YearMonth.from(end) }.toList().takeLast(12)26    SpendingBars("Income trend · actual", months.map { m -> m.toString() to finance.income.filter {27        val date = Instant.ofEpochMilli(it.timestamp).atZone(zone).toLocalDate(); date in maxOf(start, m.atDay(1))..minOf(end, m.atEndOfMonth())28    }.sumOf { it.cents } })29    val budgets = finance.budgets.filter { YearMonth.parse(it.month) in YearMonth.from(start)..YearMonth.from(end) }30    LedgerCard {31        Text("Budget vs actual", style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium)32        if (budgets.isEmpty()) Text("No budgets configured for this period", style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall)33        budgets.forEach { Text("${it.month} · ${state.categories.find { c -> c.id == it.categoryId }?.name ?: "Overall"}: ${Money.format(financeBudgetSpending(it, state.expenses, zone))} / ${Money.format(it.cents)}", style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall) }34        if (budgets.isNotEmpty()) Text("Budgets apply to full calendar months.", style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall)35    }36    val forecastMonth = maxOf(YearMonth.from(today), month)37    val forecast = plannedOccurrences(finance.recurring, forecastMonth)38    LedgerCard {39        Text("Forecast · $forecastMonth · planned", style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium)40        Text("Expected income ${Money.format(forecast.filter { it.kind == "Income" }.sumOf { it.cents })}")41        Text("Scheduled commitments ${Money.format(forecast.filter { it.kind == "Expense" }.sumOf { it.cents })}")42        Text("Planned available ${Money.format(monthlyMoney(forecastMonth, forecast, emptyList(), emptyList()).plannedAvailable)}")43        Text("Plan only; future variable spending is unknown.", style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall)44    }45    val insights = financialInsights(state, finance, month, today, zone)46    LedgerCard {47        Text("Local insights", style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium)48        if (insights.isEmpty()) Text("More recorded history is needed for comparisons.", style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall)49        insights.forEach { Text(it, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium) }50    }51}52}

1package my.fuelledger.ui23import android.content.ClipData4import android.content.Intent5import android.graphics.Bitmap6import android.graphics.Canvas7import android.graphics.Color8import android.graphics.Paint9import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.*10import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme11import androidx.compose.runtime.*12import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalContext13import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp14import androidx.core.content.FileProvider15import androidx.core.graphics.createBitmap16import my.fuelledger.data.*17import my.fuelledger.domain.Money18import java.io.File1920fun journeySummary(plan: JourneyPlan): String {21    val cost = journeyCost(plan)22    return listOf(plan.routeName.ifBlank { "Journey estimate" }, "${plan.origin} → ${plan.destination}",23        "Distance: ${number(cost.distanceKm)} km", "Fuel: ${Money.format(cost.fuelCents)}", "Tolls: ${Money.format(cost.tollCents)}",24        "Parking: ${Money.format(cost.parkingCents)}", "Estimated total: ${Money.format(cost.totalCents)}", "Estimate only · generated offline").joinToString("\n")25}26@Composable fun JourneyShareActions(plan: JourneyPlan) {27    val context = LocalContext.current28    var error by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }29    val text = journeySummary(plan)30    Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {31        TextButton({ runCatching { context.startActivity(Intent.createChooser(Intent(Intent.ACTION_SEND).apply { type = "text/plain"; putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_TEXT, text) }, "Export journey")) }.onFailure { error = "No compatible sharing app is available." } }) { Text("Share text") }32        TextButton({ runCatching {33            val directory = File(context.cacheDir, "local-exports").apply { mkdirs() }34            val file = File.createTempFile("journey-", ".png", directory)35            val lines = text.lines().flatMap { it.chunked(48) }36            val bitmap = createBitmap(1000, 100 + lines.size * 48)37            try {38                val canvas = Canvas(bitmap); canvas.drawColor(Color.rgb(11, 18, 32))39                val paint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply { color = Color.rgb(243, 246, 250); textSize = 32f }40                lines.forEachIndexed { i, line -> canvas.drawText(line, 40f, 65f + i * 48, paint) }41                file.outputStream().use { check(bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.PNG, 100, it)) }42            } finally { bitmap.recycle() }43            val uri = FileProvider.getUriForFile(context, "${context.packageName}.receipt-camera", file)44            context.startActivity(Intent.createChooser(Intent(Intent.ACTION_SEND).apply { type = "image/png"; putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_STREAM, uri); clipData = ClipData.newRawUri("Journey summary", uri); addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION) }, "Export journey image"))45        }.onFailure { error = "The journey image could not be shared. Try text export." } }) { Text("Share image") }46    }47    error?.let { Text(it, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error) }48}49@Composable fun JourneyActualSummary(plan: JourneyPlan, expenses: List<Expense>) {50    val actual = journeyActual(plan, expenses); val cost = journeyCost(plan)51    Text("Estimated vs actual", style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium)52    Text("Fuel ${Money.format(cost.fuelCents)} / ${actual.fuel?.let(Money::format) ?: "Unavailable"}", style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall)53    Text("Tolls ${Money.format(cost.tollCents)} / ${actual.tolls?.let(Money::format) ?: "Unavailable"}", style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall)54    Text("Parking ${Money.format(cost.parkingCents)} / ${actual.parking?.let(Money::format) ?: "Unavailable"}", style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall)55}56@Composable fun JourneyActualEditor(journey: SavedJourney, expenses: List<Expense>, journeys: List<SavedJourney>, busy: Boolean, close: () -> Unit, save: (SavedJourney) -> Unit) {57    var links by remember(journey.id) { mutableStateOf(journey.plan().actualLinks) }58    var query by remember { mutableStateOf("") }59    val occupied = journeys.filter { it.id != journey.id }.flatMap { it.plan().actualLinks }.map { it.expenseId }.toSet()60    EditorShell("Link actual expenses", busy, null, close, { save(savedJourney(journey.id, journey.plan().copy(actualLinks = links), journey.timestamp)) }) {61        Text("Select existing expenses explicitly. This creates no transactions.", style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall)62        TextField(query, { query = it }, "Search recorded expenses", 200)63        links.filter { link -> expenses.none { it.id == link.expenseId } }.forEach { missing -> TextButton({ links = links.filterNot { it.expenseId == missing.expenseId } }) { Text("Remove missing ${missing.kind} link") } }64        expenses.filter { it.kind == "Expense" && it.id !in occupied && (it.description.contains(query, true) || it.merchant.contains(query, true)) }.take(100).forEach { expense ->65            Text("${expense.description.ifBlank { expense.merchant.ifBlank { "Expense" } }} · ${dateTime(expense.timestamp)} · ${Money.format(expense.cents)}", style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall)66            Choice("Attribution", links.find { it.expenseId == expense.id }?.kind ?: "None", listOf("None", "Fuel", "Tolls", "Parking").map { it to it }) { kind ->67                links = links.filterNot { it.expenseId == expense.id } + if (kind == "None") emptyList() else listOf(JourneyActualLink(expense.id, kind))68            }69        }70        if (expenses.size > 100) Text("Search to narrow the latest 100 matching records.", style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall)71    }72}

MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)153        draft.forEach { item ->154            key(item.id) {155                Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)) {156         }161                        Text("${percentText(item.basisPoints)}%", style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium)162                    }163                    Slider(item.basisPoints.toFloat(), { if (interaction()) update(moveAllocation(draft, item.id, it.roundToInt())) },164                        enabled = !busy && item.id != flexible, valueRange = modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) { Text("Add allocation category") }175        error?.let { Text(it, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error) }176        Button({ runCatching { allocationPlan(scope, draft) }.onSuccess { vm.saveAllocation(it) {} }.onFailure { error = it.message } }, enabled = !busy, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) { Text("Save allocations · 100%") }177        if (scope != "default" && stored != null) TextButton({ vm.resetAllocation(scope) {} }, enabled = !busy) { Text("Use default allocations") }178        ExpandableHelp("Allocation rules") { No money is allocated when available is zero or negative. Savings is a planned reserve. Try another local destination." } finally { busy = false }33        }34    }35    val pdf = rememberLauncherForActivityResult(ActivityResultContracts.CreateDocument("application/pdf")) { uri ->36        val report = pending; pending = null37        if (uri != null && report != null) scope.launch {38            busy = true39            try { withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {40                val document = PdfDocument()41                try {42                    val lines = report.lines().flatMap { it.chunked(86) }43                    val paint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply { textSize = 11f; color = android.graphics.Color.BLACK }44                    lines.chunked(48).forEachIndexed { index, pageLines ->45                        val page = document.startPage(PdfDocument.PageInfo.Builder(595, 842, index + 1).create())46                        pageLines.forEachIndexed { row, line -> page.canvas.drawText(line, 32f, 42f + row * 15, paint) }47                        document.finishPage(page)48                    }49                    context.contentResolver.openOutputStream(uri, "wt")?.use { document.writeTo(it) } ?: error("Document unavailable")50                } finally { document.close() }51            }; message = "PDF saved" } catch (_: Exception) { message = "PDF could not be saved. Try another local destination." } finally { busy = false }52        }53    }54    Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {55        OutlinedButton({ pending = financialReport(state, finance, start, end, ZoneId.systemDefault()); csv.launch("financial-report-$start-$end.csv") }, enabled = !busy && end >= start, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) { Text("Export CSV") }56        OutlinedButton({ pending = financialReport(state, finance, start, end, ZoneId.systemDefault()); pdf.launch("financial-report-$start-$end.pdf") }, enabled = !busy && end >= start, modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) { Text("Export PDF") }57    }58    message?.let { Text(it, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall) }59}

1package my.fuelledger.widgets23import android.app.PendingIntent4import android.appwidget.AppWidgetManager5import android.appwidget.AppWidgetProvider6import android.content.ComponentName7import android.content.Context8import android.content.Intent9import android.widget.RemoteViews10import kotlinx.coroutines.*11import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.first12import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.Mutex13import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.withLock14import androidx.room.withTransaction15import my.fuelledger.LedgerApplication16import my.fuelledger.MainActivity17import my.fuelledger.R18import my.fuelledger.data.*19import my.fuelledger.domain.Money20import java.time.*2122/** Standard RemoteViews widgets: no services, network, cached plaintext amounts or new libraries. */23open class LedgerWidgetProvider : AppWidgetProvider() {24    override fun onUpdate(context: Context, manager: AppWidgetManager, ids: IntArray) = refresh(context)25    override fun onReceive(context: Context, intent: Intent) { super.onReceive(context, intent)26        if (intent.action in listOf(Intent.ACTION_DATE_CHANGED, Intent.ACTION_TIMEZONE_CHANGED, Intent.ACTION_TIME_CHANGED)) refresh(context)27    }28    private fun refresh(context: Context) {29        val result = goAsync()30        CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.IO).launch {31            try { LedgerWidgets.update(context); (context.applicationContext as LedgerApplication).scheduleRecurring() }32            catch (_: Exception) { LedgerWidgets.unavailable(context) }33            finally { result?.finish() }34        }35    }36}37class ExpenseSummaryWidget : LedgerWidgetProvider()38class QuickAddWidget : LedgerWidgetProvider()39class FinancialOverviewWidget : LedgerWidgetProvider()4041data class WidgetSummary(val month: String, val expenses: Long, val income: Long, val budget: Long?, val hidden: Boolean, val budgetSpent: Long = expenses, val budgetLabel: String = "Overall budget") {42    fun money(value: Long) = if (hidden) "RM ••••" else Money.format(value)43    fun budgetLine() = budget?.let { if (hidden) "Budget usage hidden" else "$budgetLabel · ${budgetSpent * 100 / it}% used · ${Money.format(it - budgetSpent)} remaining" } ?: "Monthly budget not configured"44}45fun widgetSummary(snapshot: Backup, month: YearMonth, zone: ZoneId): WidgetSummary {46    val expenses = snapshot.expenses.filter { YearMonth.from(Instant.ofEpochMilli(it.timestamp).atZone(zone)) == month }47    val budgets = snapshot.budgets.filter { it.month == month.toString() }48    val overall = budgets.find { it.categoryId.isEmpty() }49    val budget = overall?.cents ?: budgets.takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }?.sumOf { it.cents }50    val categoryIds = budgets.map { it.categoryId }.toSet()51    return WidgetSummary(month.toString(), expenses.sumOf { it.cents }, financeMonthlyIncome(snapshot.incomes, month, zone), budget,52        snapshot.settings.widgetPrivacy || snapshot.settings.privacyMode,53        if (overall != null) expenses.sumOf { it.cents } else expenses.filter { it.categoryId in categoryIds }.sumOf { it.cents },54        if (overall != null) "Overall budget" else "Category budgets")55}5657object LedgerWidgets {58    // Preference writes, receiver refreshes and ledger commits can overlap. Serialize each59    // snapshot/render batch so a stale refresh cannot finish over a newer privacy state.60    private val updates = Mutex()61    private val providers = listOf(ExpenseSummaryWidget::class.java, QuickAddWidget::class.java, FinancialOverviewWidget::class.java)62    private fun pending(context: Context, action: String): PendingIntent = PendingIntent.getActivity(context, action.hashCode(),63        Intent(context, MainActivity::class.java).apply { putExtra("ledger_action", action); flags = Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TOP or Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_SINGLE_TOP },64        PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT or PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE)65    suspend fun update(context: Context) = updates.withLock { updateLocked(context) }66    private suspend fun updateLocked(context: Context) {67        val manager = AppWidgetManager.getInstance(context)68        val ids = providers.associateWith { manager.getAppWidgetIds(ComponentName(context, it)) }69        if (ids.values.all { it.isEmpty() }) return70        val repository = (context.applicationContext as LedgerApplication).repository71        repository.initialize()72        val month = YearMonth.now(); val zone = ZoneId.systemDefault()73        val start = month.atDay(1).atStartOfDay(zone).toInstant().toEpochMilli()74        val end = month.plusMonths(1).atDay(1).atStartOfDay(zone).toInstant().toEpochMilli()75        val summary = repository.database.withTransaction {76            val settings = repository.preferences.settings.first()77            val budgets = repository.database.financeDao().monthBudgets(month.toString())78            val overall = budgets.find { it.categoryId.isEmpty() }79            val total = repository.dao.sumExpenses(start, end)80            WidgetSummary(month.toString(), total, repository.database.financeDao().sumIncome(start, end),81                overall?.cents ?: budgets.takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }?.sumOf { it.cents }, settings.widgetPrivacy || settings.privacyMode,82                if (overall != null) total else if (budgets.isNotEmpty()) repository.dao.sumCategoryExpenses(start, end, budgets.map { it.categoryId }) else 0,83                if (overall != null) "Overall budget" else "Category budgets")84        }85        for ((provider, widgets) in ids) widgets.forEach { id ->86            val view = RemoteViews(context.packageName, R.layout.ledger_widget)87            view.setTextViewText(R.id.widget_title, when(provider) { ExpenseSummaryWidget::class.java -> "${summary.month} · Expenses"; QuickAddWidget::class.java -> "Quick add"; else -> "${summary.month} · Actual cash flow" })88            view.setTextViewText(R.id.widget_main, when(provider) { ExpenseSummaryWidget::class.java -> summary.money(summary.expenses); QuickAddWidget::class.java -> "Fuel & Expense Tracker"; else -> "Income ${summary.money(summary.income)}\nExpenses ${summary.money(summary.expenses)}" })89            view.setViewVisibility(R.id.widget_main, if (provider == QuickAddWidget::class.java) android.view.View.GONE else android.view.View.VISIBLE)90            view.setTextViewText(R.id.widget_detail, when(provider) { ExpenseSummaryWidget::class.java -> summary.budgetLine(); QuickAddWidget::class.java -> "Open entry form"; else -> "Net ${summary.money(summary.income - summary.expenses)}\nCash flow · not a bank balance" })91            view.setOnClickPendingIntent(R.id.widget_root, pending(context, "Home"))92            view.setViewVisibility(R.id.widget_actions, if (provider == QuickAddWidget::class.java) android.view.View.VISIBLE else android.view.View.GONE)93            view.setOnClickPendingIntent(R.id.widget_expense, pending(context, "Expense"))94            view.setOnClickPendingIntent(R.id.widget_income, pending(context, "Income"))95            view.setOnClickPendingIntent(R.id.widget_scan, pending(context, "Scan"))96            manager.updateAppWidget(id, view)97        }98    }99    suspend fun unavailable(context: Context) = updates.withLock {100        val manager = AppWidgetManager.getInstance(context)101        providers.forEach { provider -> manager.getAppWidgetIds(ComponentName(context, provider)).forEach { id ->102            val view = RemoteViews(context.packageName, R.layout.ledger_widget)103            view.setTextViewText(R.id.widget_title, "Fuel & Expense Tracker")104            view.setTextViewText(R.id.widget_main, "Open app to refresh")105            view.setTextViewText(R.id.widget_detail, "Local records remain protected")106            view.setOnClickPendingIntent(R.id.widget_root, pending(context, "Home"))107            manager.updateAppWidget(id, view)108        } }109    }110}

1package my.fuelledger.data23import kotlinx.serialization.decodeFromString4import org.junit.Assert.*5import org.junit.Test67class ExpenseEntryTest {8    @Test fun manualCategoryChoicesOmitDedicatedFuelButKeepTransportParkingTollsAndHistoricalIds() {9        val transport = listOf("Transport", "Parking", "Tolls").map { Category(it.lowercase(), it, "fuel", 1L) }10        val choices = manualExpenseCategories(defaultCategories + transport)11        assertFalse(choices.any { it.id == FUEL_CATEGORY })12        assertTrue(choices.containsAll(transport)); assertEquals(OTHER_CATEGORY, choices.last().id)13        assertTrue(defaultCategories.any { it.id == FUEL_CATEGORY })14        assertEquals(listOf("E-wallet", "Cash", "Card"), expensePaymentOptions)15    }1617    @Test fun cardDisplayGroupingPreservesHistoricalStringsUnlessUserChangesGroup() {18        for (raw in listOf("Credit Card", "Debit Card", "Card")) {19            assertEquals("Card", expensePaymentGroup(raw))20            assertEquals(raw, selectExpensePayment(raw, "Card"))21            assertEquals("Cash", selectExpensePayment(raw, "Cash"))22            validateExpense(Expense("legacy", 12345, "food", 1000, payment = raw))23        }24        assertEquals("E-wallet", selectExpensePayment("Not specified", "E-wallet"))25        assertNull(expensePaymentGroup("Not specified"))26        validateExpense(Expense("unknown", 12345, "food", 1000, payment = "Not specified"))27        assertFalse("Not specified" in expensePaymentOptions)28        assertTrue(runCatching { selectExpensePayment("Cash", "Not specified") }.isFailure)29    }30    @Test fun oldSettingsAndExpenseJsonKeepOriginalValuesAndSafeNewPreference() {31        val old = backupJson.decodeFromString<AppSettings>("""{"theme":"Dark","consumption":8.5}""")32        assertEquals("Cash", old.lastExpensePayment); assertEquals("Dark", old.theme)33        val expense = backupJson.decodeFromString<Expense>("""{"id":"old","cents":12345,"categoryId":"food","timestamp":1000,"payment":"Debit Card"}""")34        assertEquals(12345L, expense.cents); assertEquals("Debit Card", expense.payment)35        assertTrue(runCatching { old.copy(lastExpensePayment = "Not specified").validate() }.isFailure)36    }37}

1package my.fuelledger.data23import android.database.sqlite.SQLiteDatabase4import androidx.room.Room5import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider6import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.first7import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking8import org.json.JSONObject9import org.junit.*10import org.junit.Assert.*11import org.junit.runner.RunWith12import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner13import org.robolectric.annotation.Config14import java.io.File15import java.time.*1617@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner::class)18@Config(sdk = [26, 35], application = android.app.Application::class)19class ExpenseToolsTest {20    private lateinit var db: LedgerDatabase21    private lateinit var repo: LedgerRepository22    @Before fun setup() = runBlocking { db = Room.inMemoryDatabaseBuilder(ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext(), LedgerDatabase::class.java).build(); repo = LedgerRepository(db, MemorySettings()); repo.initialize() }23    @After fun close() { db.close() }24    @Test fun refundsReduceSpendingAndRejectOverRefundWithoutChangingIncome() = runBlocking {25        val e = Expense("original", 2000, "food", 1000, merchant = "Cafe")26        repo.saveExpense(e)27        repo.saveExpense(e.copy(id = "refund", cents = -500, kind = "Refund", refundOf = e.id))28        assertEquals(1500L, db.dao().allExpenses().sumOf { it.cents })29        assertTrue(db.financeDao().allIncome().isEmpty())30        assertTrue(runCatching { repo.saveExpense(e.copy(id = "over", cents = -1600, kind = "Refund", refundOf = e.id)) }.isFailure)31        assertEquals(2, db.dao().allExpenses().size)32        assertTrue(runCatching { repo.saveExpense(e.copy(cents = 400)) }.isFailure)33        repo.deleteExpense(e.id)34        val refund = db.dao().expense("refund")!!35        repo.saveExpense(refund.copy(notes = "Original purchase removed; keep provenance"))36        assertEquals(e.id, db.dao().expense("refund")!!.refundOf)37    }38    @Test fun undoSurvivesRepositoryRecreationAndRefusesToOverwriteNewEdits() = runBlocking {39        val e = Expense("e", 1200, "food", 1000)40        repo.saveExpense(e); repo.deleteExpense(e.id)41        val entry = db.toolsDao().allUndo().single()42        LedgerRepository(db, MemorySettings()).undoTransaction(entry.id)43        assertEquals(e, db.dao().expense(e.id))44        repo.saveExpense(e.copy(cents = 1300))45        val previous = db.toolsDao().allUndo().single()46        repo.saveExpense(e.copy(cents = 1400))47        assertTrue(runCatching { repo.undoTransaction(previous.id) }.isFailure)48        repo.undoTransaction(db.toolsDao().allUndo().first { it.change().after?.cents == 1400L }.id)49        assertEquals(1300L, db.dao().expense(e.id)!!.cents)50    }51    @Test fun undoCannotReducePurchaseBelowRefundsAddedAfterTheEdit() = runBlocking {52        val original = Expense("purchase", 1000, "food", 1000)53        repo.saveExpense(original)54        val increased = original.copy(cents = 2000)55        repo.saveExpense(increased)56        val edit = db.toolsDao().allUndo().single()57        repo.saveExpense(original.copy(id = "refund", cents = -1500, kind = "Refund", refundOf = original.id))58        assertTrue(runCatching { repo.undoTransaction(edit.id) }.isFailure)59        assertEquals(increased, db.dao().expense(original.id))60        assertNotNull(db.toolsDao().undo(edit.id))61        repo.deleteExpense("refund")62        repo.undoTransaction(edit.id)63        assertEquals(original, db.dao().expense(original.id))64    }65    @Test fun favouritesAndMerchantMemoryRoundTripThroughBackup() = runBlocking {66        val e = Expense("e", 1500, "food", 1000, "Lunch", payment = "Card", merchant = "Cafe")67        repo.saveExpense(e); repo.saveFavourite(favourite("f", "Lunch", e))68        val snapshot = repo.backup(); snapshot.validate(); repo.restore(snapshot)69        assertEquals("Lunch", db.toolsDao().allFavourites().single().name)70        assertEquals("Card", db.receiptAutomationDao().allMerchants().single().payment)71        assertEquals("Lunch", db.receiptAutomationDao().allMerchants().single().description)72    }73    @Test fun duplicateRulesAndSearchDoNotInventMatches() {74        val e = Expense("e", 1000, "food", 1000, "Lunch", payment = "Credit Card", merchant = "Cafe")75        assertEquals(1, likelyDuplicates(e.copy(id = "new", timestamp = 1100), listOf(e)).size)76        assertTrue(likelyDuplicates(e.copy(id = "new", merchant = "Other cafe"), listOf(e)).isEmpty())77        assertTrue(matchesExpense(e, "Cafe 10.00 card", defaultCategories, ZoneOffset.UTC))78        assertFalse(matchesExpense(e, "groceries", defaultCategories, ZoneOffset.UTC))79    }80    @Test fun calendarUsesLocalDatesAndNeverAddsScheduledPayments() {81        val zone = ZoneId.of("Asia/Kuala_Lumpur"); val day = LocalDate.of(2026, 2, 1)82        val e = Expense("e", 1000, "food", day.atStartOfDay(zone).toInstant().toEpochMilli())83        val summary = calendarSummary(listOf(e), YearMonth.of(2026, 2), zone, day.plusDays(3))84        assertEquals(1000L, summary.total); assertEquals(day, summary.highestDay); assertEquals(250.0, summary.dailyAverageSen, .001)85        assertEquals(0L, calendarSummary(listOf(e), YearMonth.of(2026, 1), zone, day).total)86    }87    @Test fun versionFourMigrationPreservesExpensePaymentCategoryAndAddsOnlyDefaults() = runBlocking {88        val context = ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext<android.content.Context>()89        val name = "migration-four-five.db"; context.deleteDatabase(name)90        val file = context.getDatabasePath(name); file.parentFile!!.mkdirs()91        val schema = JSONObject(File("schemas/my.fuelledger.data.LedgerDatabase/4.json").readText()).getJSONObject("database")92        SQLiteDatabase.openOrCreateDatabase(file, null).use { old ->93            val entities = schema.getJSONArray("entities")94            repeat(entities.length()) { index -> val entity = entities.getJSONObject(index); old.execSQL(entity.getString("createSql").replace("\${TABLE_NAME}", entity.getString("tableName"))); val indices = entity.optJSONArray("indices") ?: org.json.JSONArray(); repeat(indices.length()) { old.execSQL(indices.getJSONObject(it).getString("createSql").replace("\${TABLE_NAME}", entity.getString("tableName"))) } }95            old.execSQL("INSERT INTO categories VALUES ('food','Food & Drinks','food',4293495383,0)")96            old.execSQL("INSERT INTO expenses(id,cents,categoryId,timestamp,description,notes,payment) VALUES ('old',1234,'food',1000,'Old lunch','Keep me','Credit Card')")97            old.version = 498        }99        val migrated = Room.databaseBuilder(context, LedgerDatabase::class.java, name).addMigrations(LedgerDatabase.MIGRATION_4_5).build()100        try { val e = migrated.dao().expense("old")!!; assertEquals(1234L, e.cents); assertEquals("Credit Card", e.payment); assertEquals("Expense", e.kind); assertEquals("", e.merchant); assertNull(e.refundOf); assertEquals(5, migrated.openHelper.readableDatabase.version) } finally { migrated.close(); context.deleteDatabase(name) }101    }102    @Test fun refuelUndoRestoresBothRecordsAtomicallyAndRejectsInvalidOdometerRestores() = runBlocking {103        val fuel = Refuel("fill", 1000, 1000.0, 40.0, 8000, true)104        repo.saveRefuel(fuel)105        repo.saveRefuel(fuel.copy(cents = 9000))106        repo.undoTransaction(db.toolsDao().allUndo().single().id)107        assertEquals(fuel, db.dao().allRefuels().single())108        assertEquals(8000L, db.dao().allExpenses().single().cents)109        repo.deleteRefuel(fuel.id)110        assertTrue(db.dao().allExpenses().isEmpty())111        repo.undoTransaction(db.toolsDao().allUndo().single().id)112        assertEquals(fuel, db.dao().allRefuels().single())113        assertEquals(fuel.cents, db.dao().allExpenses().single().cents)114    }115    @Test fun undoRestoresReceiptReferenceAndExplicitImageDeletionKeepsTransactions() = runBlocking {116        val photo = "12345678-abcd-1234-abcd-123456789abc.jpg"117        val e = Expense("e", 2000, "food", 1000, receiptFile = photo)118        repo.saveExpense(e); repo.deleteExpense(e.id)119        repo.undoTransaction(db.toolsDao().allUndo().single().id)120        assertEquals(photo, db.dao().expense(e.id)!!.receiptFile)121        repo.saveExpense(e.copy(cents = 2100)); repo.removeReceiptImages()122        assertNull(db.dao().expense(e.id)!!.receiptFile)123        assertNull(db.toolsDao().allUndo().single().change().before.receiptFile)124        assertEquals(2100L, db.dao().expense(e.id)!!.cents)125    }126    @Test fun actualExpenseAttributionCannotBeDuplicatedAcrossJourneys() = runBlocking {127        val e = Expense("toll", 1000, FUEL_CATEGORY, 1000)128        repo.saveExpense(e)129        val journeys = JourneyRepository(db)130        val plan = JourneyPlan("A", "B", 100.0, actualLinks = listOf(JourneyActualLink(e.id, "Tolls")))131        journeys.save(savedJourney("one", plan))132        assertTrue(runCatching { journeys.save(savedJourney("two", plan)) }.isFailure)133        assertEquals(1, db.journeyDao().allJourneys().size)134        assertEquals(1, db.dao().allExpenses().size)135        repo.deleteExpense(e.id)136        assertNull(journeyActual(db.journeyDao().allJourneys().single().plan(), emptyList()).tolls)137    }138139}

1package my.fuelledger.data23import android.app.Application4import androidx.room.Room5import androidx.test.core.app.ApplicationProvider6import kotlinx.coroutines.*7import kotlinx.serialization.encodeToString8import kotlinx.serialization.decodeFromString9import my.fuelledger.receipts.parseReceipt10import org.junit.*11import org.junit.Assert.*12import org.junit.runner.RunWith13import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner14import org.robolectric.annotation.Config15import java.time.*1617@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner::class)18@Config(sdk = [35], application = Application::class)19class PlannerRepositoryTest {20    private lateinit var db: LedgerDatabase21    private lateinit var ledger: LedgerRepository22    private lateinit var finance: FinanceRepository23    private val month = YearMonth.now()24    private fun date(day: Int = 1) = month.atDay(day)25    private fun rule(id: String = "rent", cents: Long = 95000L, kind: String = "Expense") = FinanceRecurring(id, id, cents, if (kind == "Income") "" else "bills", "Monthly", date().toString(), date().toString(), kind = kind, manualPayment = true)26    @Before fun setup() = runBlocking {27        db = Room.inMemoryDatabaseBuilder(ApplicationProvider.getApplicationContext(), LedgerDatabase::class.java).build()28        ledger = LedgerRepository(db, MemorySettings()); ledger.initialize(); finance = FinanceRepository(db)29    }30    @After fun close() { db.close() }31    @Test fun manualFixedAndExpectedIncomeNeverAutoPostAndPaidRetriesDoNotDuplicate() = runBlocking {32        finance.saveRecurring(rule()); finance.saveRecurring(rule("salary", 300000, "Income"))33        finance.reconcile(date(20)); assertTrue(db.dao().allExpenses().isEmpty()); assertTrue(finance.dao.allIncome().isEmpty())34        val occurrence = finance.ensureMonth(month).occurrences().first { it.kind == "Expense" }35        coroutineScope { List(3) { async(Dispatchers.IO) { finance.markPaid(occurrence, date(2), 96000) } }.awaitAll() }36        assertEquals(1, db.dao().allExpenses().size); assertEquals(96000L, db.dao().allExpenses().single().cents)37    }38    @Test fun linkExistingExpenseThenAutomaticRuleCannotCreateSecondPayment() = runBlocking {39        finance.saveRecurring(rule())40        ledger.saveExpense(Expense("existing", 94000, "bills", date().atStartOfDay(ZoneId.systemDefault()).toInstant().toEpochMilli(), "Rent paid"))41        val due = finance.ensureMonth(month).occurrences().single()42        finance.markPaid(due, date(), 95000, "existing")43        finance.saveRecurring(rule().copy(manualPayment = false))44        finance.reconcile(date(20))45        assertEquals(1, db.dao().allExpenses().size); assertEquals(94000L, db.dao().allExpenses().single().cents)46        assertEquals("rent", db.dao().allExpenses().single().recurringRuleId)47    }48    @Test fun refundCannotBeLinkedAsPaymentOfAFixedCommitment() = runBlocking {49        finance.saveRecurring(rule())50        val refund = Expense("refund", -1000, "bills", 1000, kind = "Refund")51        ledger.saveExpense(refund)52        val due = finance.ensureMonth(month).occurrences().single()53        assertTrue(runCatching { finance.markPaid(due, date(), 95000, refund.id) }.isFailure)54        assertEquals(refund, db.dao().expense(refund.id))55        assertNull(db.dao().occurrence(due.ruleId, due.date))56    }57    @Test fun paymentEditsKeepProvenanceAndDeletingPaymentReopensIt() = runBlocking {58        finance.saveRecurring(rule()); val due = finance.ensureMonth(month).occurrences().single()59        finance.markPaid(due, date(), 95000)60        val paid = db.dao().allExpenses().single()61        ledger.saveExpense(paid.copy(cents = 97000, recurringRuleId = null, recurringDate = null))62        assertEquals("rent", db.dao().allExpenses().single().recurringRuleId)63        ledger.deleteExpense(paid.id); assertNull(db.dao().occurrence("rent", due.date))64        finance.markPaid(due, date(), 98000); assertEquals(98000L, db.dao().allExpenses().single().cents)65    }66    @Test fun pausedEditedDeletedRulesPreservePastMonthlySnapshots() = runBlocking {67        val last = month.minusMonths(1)68        val rule = rule().copy(startDate = last.atDay(1).toString(), nextDate = last.atDay(1).toString())69        finance.saveRecurring(rule)70        val before = finance.ensureMonth(last)71        finance.saveRecurring(rule.copy(cents = 120000, enabled = false))72        assertEquals(before, finance.ensureMonth(last)); assertTrue(finance.ensureMonth(month).occurrences().isEmpty())73        finance.deleteRecurring(rule.id); assertEquals(before, finance.ensureMonth(last))74    }75    @Test fun defaultAllocationChangesPreservePastAndMonthOverrideIsIndependent() = runBlocking {76        val last = month.minusMonths(1)77        finance.ensureMonth(last)78        val old = allocationPlan("default", defaultAllocations)79        finance.saveAllocation(old)80        val changed = listOf(AllocationCategory("reserve", "Savings", 10000, savings = true))81        finance.saveAllocation(allocationPlan("default", changed))82        assertEquals(defaultAllocations, db.plannerDao().allAllocations().single { it.scope == last.toString() }.categories())83        finance.saveAllocation(allocationPlan(month.toString(), defaultAllocations))84        assertEquals(changed, db.plannerDao().allAllocations().single { it.scope == "default" }.categories())85        finance.resetAllocation(month.toString())86        assertFalse(db.plannerDao().allAllocations().any { it.scope == month.toString() })87        assertTrue(db.dao().allExpenses().isEmpty())88    }89    @Test fun missedMonthsReconcileAsPlansWithoutFinancialTransactions() = runBlocking {90        val prior = month.minusMonths(3)91        finance.dao.putRecurring(rule().copy(startDate = prior.atDay(1).toString(), nextDate = prior.atDay(1).toString()))92        finance.ensureMonth(prior); finance.reconcile()93        assertEquals((0L..3L).map { prior.plusMonths(it).toString() }, db.plannerDao().allMonths().map { it.month })94        assertTrue(db.dao().allExpenses().isEmpty())95    }96    @Test fun journeyCrudAndDuplicateHaveNoExpenseOrFuelSideEffects() = runBlocking {97        val repository = JourneyRepository(db)98        val first = savedJourney("first", JourneyPlan("KL", "Penang", 350.0))99        repository.save(first); repository.save(first.copy(payload = backupJson.encodeToString(first.plan().copy(parkingCents = 100))))100        repository.save(savedJourney("duplicate", first.plan().copy(petrolPrice = "3.00")))101        assertEquals(2, db.journeyDao().allJourneys().size)102        assertTrue(db.dao().allExpenses().isEmpty()); assertTrue(db.dao().allRefuels().isEmpty())103        repository.delete("first"); assertEquals("duplicate", db.journeyDao().allJourneys().single().id)104    }105    private fun receipt() = parseReceipt("McDonald's\n${LocalDate.now()}\nGRAND TOTAL RM12.34")106    private fun receiptExpense(id: String = "scan") = Expense(id, 1234, "food", date().atTime(12, 0).atZone(ZoneId.systemDefault()).toInstant().toEpochMilli(), "McDonald's", payment = "Not specified")107    @Test fun receiptAtomicSaveDeduplicatesConcurrentScansAndUndoRemovesOnlyItsExpense() = runBlocking {108        ledger.saveSettings(AppSettings(receiptSaveMode = "Smart"))109        val receipt = receipt(); val fingerprint = receiptFingerprint(receipt.rawText)110        val saved = receiptExpense().copy(timestamp = LocalDate.now().atTime(12, 0).atZone(ZoneId.systemDefault()).toInstant().toEpochMilli())111        val outcomes = coroutineScope { List(3) { async(Dispatchers.IO) { runCatching { ledger.saveReceiptExpense(saved, receipt, fingerprint, true, true) } } }.awaitAll() }112        assertEquals(1, outcomes.count { it.isSuccess }); assertEquals(1, db.dao().allExpenses().size)113        assertEquals("food", db.receiptAutomationDao().allMerchants().single().categoryId)114        assertEquals(saved.cents, financeBudgetSpending(FinanceBudget("limit", month.toString(), 5000), db.dao().allExpenses()))115        ledger.undoReceiptExpense(saved)116        assertTrue(db.dao().allExpenses().isEmpty()); assertTrue(db.receiptAutomationDao().allScans().isEmpty())117    }118    @Test fun automaticSavingRequiresEnabledModeAndUnchangedExtractedFields() = runBlocking {119        val receipt = receipt(); val value = receiptExpense().copy(timestamp = LocalDate.now().atTime(12, 0).atZone(ZoneId.systemDefault()).toInstant().toEpochMilli())120        val fingerprint = receiptFingerprint(receipt.rawText)121        assertTrue(runCatching { ledger.saveReceiptExpense(value, receipt, fingerprint, false, true) }.isFailure)122        ledger.saveSettings(AppSettings(receiptSaveMode = "Smart"))123        assertTrue(runCatching { ledger.saveReceiptExpense(value.copy(cents = 9999), receipt, fingerprint, false, true) }.isFailure)124        assertTrue(runCatching { ledger.saveReceiptExpense(value.copy(description = "Other merchant"), receipt, fingerprint, false, true) }.isFailure)125        assertTrue(db.dao().allExpenses().isEmpty()); assertTrue(db.receiptAutomationDao().allScans().isEmpty())126    }127    @Test fun incompleteReceiptCannotAutoSaveAndReviewCanCorrectMissingFields() = runBlocking {128        val receipt = parseReceipt("Watsons\nTOTAL RM12.34")129        val value = receiptExpense()130        assertTrue(runCatching { ledger.saveReceiptExpense(value, receipt, receiptFingerprint(receipt.rawText), false, true) }.isFailure)131        assertTrue(db.dao().allExpenses().isEmpty()); assertTrue(db.receiptAutomationDao().allScans().isEmpty())132        ledger.saveReceiptExpense(value, receipt, receiptFingerprint(receipt.rawText), false, false)133        assertEquals(1, db.dao().allExpenses().size)134    }135    @Test fun petrolReceiptLinksExistingRefuelInsteadOfDuplicatingFuel() = runBlocking {136        val stamp = LocalDate.now().atTime(12, 0).atZone(ZoneId.systemDefault()).toInstant().toEpochMilli()137        ledger.saveRefuel(Refuel("fill", stamp, 1000.0, 10.0, 1234, false, "Petronas"))138        val receipt = parseReceipt("PETRONAS\n${LocalDate.now()}\nTOTAL RM12.34")139        assertTrue(possibleReceiptDuplicate(receipt, db.dao().allExpenses()))140        assertTrue(runCatching { ledger.saveReceiptExpense(receiptExpense(), receipt, receiptFingerprint(receipt.rawText), false, false) }.isFailure)141        ledger.attachScannedReceipt(db.dao().allExpenses().single().id, null, receiptFingerprint(receipt.rawText))142        assertEquals(1, db.dao().allExpenses().size); assertEquals(1, db.dao().allRefuels().size)143    }144    @Test fun undoRejectsChangedTransactionAndNormalDeletionRetainsDuplicateTombstone() = runBlocking {145        val receipt = receipt(); val value = receiptExpense(); val fingerprint = receiptFingerprint(receipt.rawText)146        ledger.saveReceiptExpense(value, receipt, fingerprint, false, false)147        ledger.saveExpense(value.copy(cents = 1500))148        assertTrue(runCatching { ledger.undoReceiptExpense(value) }.isFailure)149        ledger.deleteExpense(value.id); assertNotNull(db.receiptAutomationDao().scan(fingerprint))150        assertTrue(runCatching { ledger.saveReceiptExpense(value.copy(id = "second"), receipt, fingerprint, false, false) }.isFailure)151    }152    @Test fun allPlannerJourneyAndReceiptMetadataSurviveBackupRoundTrip() = runBlocking {153        finance.saveRecurring(rule()); finance.saveRecurring(rule("salary", 300000, "Income"))154        finance.saveAllocation(allocationPlan("default", defaultAllocations))155        JourneyRepository(db).save(savedJourney("route", JourneyPlan("KL", "Ipoh", 200.0)))156        val receipt = receipt(); ledger.saveReceiptExpense(receiptExpense(), receipt, receiptFingerprint(receipt.rawText), true, false)157        val snapshot = ledger.backup(); snapshot.validate()158        val decoded = backupJson.decodeFromString<Backup>(backupJson.encodeToString(snapshot))159        ledger.restore(decoded)160        assertEquals(snapshot.copy(createdAt = 0), ledger.backup().copy(createdAt = 0))161    }162}

1package my.fuelledger.data23import my.fuelledger.domain.*4import my.fuelledger.receipts.*5import org.junit.Assert.*6import org.junit.Test7import java.time.*89class PlanningCalculationsTest {10    private val month = YearMonth.of(2026, 2)11    private val zone = ZoneId.of("Asia/Kuala_Lumpur")12    private fun rule(id: String, cents: Long, day: Int = 1, kind: String = "Expense") = requestedMonthlyExampleUsesExpectedRatherThanReceivedIncome() {16        val plan = plannedOccurrences(listOf(rule("salary", 300000, kind = "Income"), rule("rent", 95000), rule("wifi", 12000, 15), rule("mobile", 6000, 20)), month)17        val money = monthlyMoney(month, plan, emptyList(), emptyList(), zone)18        assertEquals(300000L, money.expected); assertEquals(113000L, money.fixed)19        assertEquals(187000L, money.plannedAvailable); assertEquals(0L, money.actualNet)20    }21    @Test fun fixedPaidExpenseOnlyDeductsOnceButStaysInActualExpenditure() {22        val plan = plannedOccurrences(listOf(rule("salary", 300000, kind = "Income"), rule("rent", 95000)), month)23        val expenses = listOf(Expense("rent-paid", 96000, "bills", stamp("2026-02-01"), recurringRuleId = "rent", recurringDate = "2026-02-01"), Expense("lunch", 10000, "food", stamp("2026-02-02")))24        val money = monthlyMoney(month, plan, listOf(FinanceIncome("actual", 250000, stamp("2026-02-03"))), expenses, zone)25        assertEquals(205000L, money.plannedAvailable); assertEquals(195000L, money.remainingAllowance)26        assertEquals(106000L, money.actualExpenses); assertEquals(144000L, money.actualNet)27    }28    @Test fun negativeAvailableRemainsVisibleAndAllocatesZero() {29        val money = monthlyMoney(month, plannedOccurrences(listOf(rule("rent", month).all { it.allocated == 0L })32        assertTrue(allocationAmounts(0, defaultAllocations, emptyList(), month).all { it.allocated == 0L })33    }34    @Test fun        val parts = listOf(AllocationCategory("a", "A", 3333), AllocationCategory("b", "B", 3333), AllocationCategory("c", "C", 3334))37        assertEquals(listOf(0L, 0L, 1L), allocationAmounts(1, parts, emptyList(), month).map { it.allocated })38        assertEquals(Long.MAX_VALUE, allocationAmounts(Long.MAX_VALUE, parts, emptyList(), month).sumOf { it.allocated })39    }40    @Test fun listOf(AllocationCategory("x", "X", -1), AllocationCategory("y", "Y", 10001)),43            listOf(AllocationCategory("x", "X", 5000, listOf("food")), AllocationCategory("y", "Y", 5000, listOf("food"))),44            listOf(AllocationCategory("x", "X", 10000, listOf("food"), savings = true)))45        cases.forEach { assertTrue(runCatching { allocationPlan("default", it) }.isFailure) }46    }47    @Test fun prepaidCommitmentForAnotherMonthCountsAsUnreservedSpendingHere() {48        val due = PlannedOccurrence("rent", "2026-03-01", "Rent", 95000, "bills", "Expense")49        val expense = Expense("early", 95000, "bills", stamp("2026-02-28"), recurringRuleId = "rent", recurringDate = due.date)50        assertEquals(95000L, monthlyMoney(month, emptyList(), emptyList(), listOf(expense), zone).variableExpenses)51        assertEquals(95000L, allocationAmounts(100000, defaultAllocations, listOf(expense), month, zone).sumOf { it.spent })52    }53    @Test fun categorySpendingIgnoresFixedPaymentsAndSavingsNeverBecomesExpense() {54        val expenses = listOf(Expense("variable", 1000, "food", stamp("2026-02-01")), Expense("fixed", 2000, "food",
